items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉秦永沛：台積電卓越製造沒有捷徑 近40年靠團隊一步一腳印
items.title_en: TSMC Executive Qin Yong‑pei Named 15th Academician of ITRI: No Shortcut to TSMC’s Manufacturing Excellence, Built Step by Step Over 40 Years
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)執行副總經理暨共同營運長秦永沛今(7)日獲選第15屆工研院院士。他在致詞時表示，工研院長年扮演台灣科技產業「開路先鋒」與人才培育的重要角色，當年正是透過工研院的人才培育與技術轉移，為台積電成立奠定關鍵基礎，也點燃台灣半導體產業走向世界的曙光。
秦永沛表示，今日能獲選工研院院士，對他而言是一份無上的肯定與榮譽。他回顧台灣半導體產業發展指出，台灣今日能在全球半導體產業占有關鍵地位，可說是一部「台灣奇蹟」，而工研院在最關鍵的時刻，為產業茁壯灌溉養分。
他指出，當年工研院透過人才培育與技術轉移，在台積電成立初期提供重要人才基礎，不僅造就今日台積電的成功，也進一步帶動整體台灣半導體產業走向全球。這份連結不只是技術傳承，更是台灣半導體產業走向世界的重要起點。
秦永沛1982年自成功大學電機研究所畢業後，即加入工研院電子所，先後投入品質保證(QA)及研發工作。他表示，電子所提供非常好的學習環境，在前後四年半的時間裡，為他打下半導體職涯的重要基礎。
1987年，秦永沛離開工研院電子所，加入剛成立不久的台積電，成為早期員工之一。回顧近40年的台積電生涯，他強調，半導體的卓越製造與技術研發「沒有捷徑」，台積電能有今日成就，是在歷任董事長包括張忠謀、劉德音，現任董事長魏哲家具有遠見的領導下，以及所有同仁一步一腳印累積而來。
秦永沛表示，在台積電職涯中，長年與營運團隊共同努力，克服無數技術瓶頸，將卓越製造技術進一步轉化為量產實力，並透過大規模穩定製造支撐全球科技創新，這些成就絕對不是任何一個人能夠單獨完成，而是整個團隊長期共同努力的成果。
致詞中，秦永沛特別向台積電創辦人張忠謀致上敬意與感謝。他表示，張忠謀當年以遠見與胸襟創立晶圓代工商業模式，不僅改變全球半導體產業，也在他的職涯中給予最關鍵的啟發與信任。他同時感謝台積電董事長魏哲家、前董事長劉德音及歷年長官的領導與提攜，使營運團隊能持續在全球卓越製造的競爭賽道上全力衝刺。
秦永沛也特別感謝所有曾共同工作的台積電同仁。他表示，正是因為團隊攜手同行，才能一次又一次克服困難，將挑戰轉化為成功，同時持續創造新的製造與技術突破。
展望未來，秦永沛表示，仍將持續為台積電與台灣科技產業貢獻心力，並攜手供應鏈與產業生態系夥伴，共同推動卓越製造與永續發展。
他最後再次感謝工研院，不僅引領他踏入半導體產業，也給予他院士這份最高肯定。不過，秦永沛強調，這份榮譽不應只屬於個人，而應歸屬於台積電整個營運團隊，以及近40年來每一位堅守崗位的台積人。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Qin Yong‑pei was selected today (the 7th) as a 15th‑session Academician of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). In his remarks he said ITRI has long played a pioneering role and a key talent‑development function for Taiwan’s tech industry; it was through ITRI’s talent cultivation and technology transfer that the foundation for TSMC’s founding was laid, igniting the dawn of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry on the world stage.

Qin said being chosen as an ITRI Academician is the highest affirmation and honor for him. He reflected on the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, noting that Taiwan’s current pivotal position in the global semiconductor arena is a “Taiwan miracle,” and that ITRI supplied essential nourishment to the industry at its most critical moments.

He pointed out that, back then, ITRI’s talent training and technology transfer provided a vital talent base during TSMC’s early days, not only creating today’s TSMC success but also propelling the entire Taiwanese semiconductor industry worldwide. This link is more than a technical hand‑over; it is the crucial starting point for Taiwan’s semiconductor industry to go global.

Qin graduated in 1982 from the Electrical Engineering Graduate Institute of National Cheng Kung University and immediately joined ITRI’s Electronics Institute, working in quality assurance (QA) and R&D. He said the Electronics Institute offered an excellent learning environment and, over four and a half years, laid the foundation for his semiconductor career.

In 1987 Qin left ITRI’s Electronics Institute to join the newly founded TSMC, becoming one of its early employees. Looking back on nearly 40 years at TSMC, he emphasized that there is “no shortcut” to excellence in semiconductor manufacturing and R&D; TSMC’s achievements stem from the visionary leadership of successive chairmen—including Morris Chang, Dr. Liu De‑yin, and current chairman Dr. Wei Zhe‑jia—and the steady, step‑by‑step contributions of all colleagues.

Qin noted that throughout his TSMC career he has worked closely with the operations team to overcome countless technical bottlenecks, turning manufacturing excellence into mass‑production capability and supporting global tech innovation with large‑scale, stable production. These accomplishments are the result of long‑term collective effort, not any single individual’s work.

In his speech Qin paid special tribute to TSMC founder Morris Chang, thanking him for establishing the foundry business model with vision and generosity, which reshaped the global semiconductor industry and gave Qin the most critical inspiration and trust in his career. He also thanked Chairman Wei Zhe‑jia, former chairman Liu De‑yin, and past leaders for their guidance that enabled the operations team to sprint full‑throttle on the global excellence‑manufacturing race track.

Qin also expressed gratitude to all TSMC colleagues he has worked with, saying that it is the teamwork that has repeatedly overcome difficulties, turning challenges into successes while continuously creating new manufacturing and technology breakthroughs.

Looking ahead, Qin said he will continue to devote his energy to TSMC and Taiwan’s technology industry, collaborating with the supply chain and ecosystem partners to jointly advance manufacturing excellence and sustainable development.

He concluded by thanking ITRI again for leading him into the semiconductor field and granting him the highest honor of Academician. However, Qin stressed that this honor belongs not to an individual but to the entire TSMC operations team and every TSMC employee who has steadfastly served over the past four decades.

items.title: 金融消費評議中心完成董監事改選 杜怡靜卸任、葉啓洲接任董事長
items.title_en: Financial Consumer Council Completes Board and Supervisor Election; Du Yijing Steps Down, Yeh Chih-chou Assumes Chairmanship
paras: 財團法人金融消費評議中心今(7)日召開第六屆第一次董事及監察人會議，會中順利完成交接，由國立政治大學法學院特聘教授葉啓洲接替卸任的杜怡靜教授，出任新任董事長，並於同日正式就職。葉啓洲兼具法官、律師實務背景與深厚學術功底，他表示，未來將以「公平、專業、便利」為核心，持續精進金融爭議處理品質，深化國內金融消費者權益保障。
新任董事長葉啓洲為德國弗萊堡大學法學博士，長期深耕民事財產法與保險法領域，並專精金融消費者保護相關法制研究。他曾任法官、律師及評議中心評議委員，接任前為政大法學院副院長暨法科所所長。評議中心指出，葉啓洲橫跨產官學界與法務實務的豐沛能量，將為爭議解決機制注入強大專業動能。
葉啓洲表示，金融消費評議制度的核心價值，在於提供消費者一個公平、專業、便利且值得信賴的爭議解決機制。未來將秉持「以消費者權益為核心、以專業公正為基礎、以制度創新為動力」的原則，持續精進評議制度與案件處理品質，在兼顧金融市場穩定與金融創新的同時，更加重視金融消費者的實質權益。
葉啓洲指出，面對金融市場的快速變化及發展，評議中心除持續提供專業、公正及有效率的爭議處理機制外，須進一步強化金融消費者保護、提升金融服務業對消費者權益的重視及有效提升民眾的金融素養，同時，應綜整各種紛爭案例，提供相關爭議處理之專業洞察並積極配合監理機關相關施政政策，一同攜手促進我國金融市場公平與健全發展及強化我國消費者保護措施。
此外，葉啓洲也特別感謝前任董事長杜怡靜教授任內對金融消費爭議處理制度及消費者保護工作的投入與貢獻。評議中心將延續既有制度基礎，持續提升金融消費爭議處理的專業性、公平性及效率，並與主管機關、金融服務業、消費者團體及社會各界共同努力，建立更加公平、健全且值得信賴的金融消費環境。
paras_en: The Financial Consumer Council held its first board and supervisor meeting of the sixth term today (the 7th), successfully completing the handover. Professor Yeh Chih-chou, a distinguished professor at the College of Law, National Chengchi University, succeeded the outgoing Professor Du Yijing as the new chairman and was formally inaugurated on the same day. Yeh, who brings both judicial and legal practice experience as well as strong academic credentials, said he will focus on “fairness, professionalism, and convenience” as core principles, continuously improving the quality of financial dispute resolution and deepening protection of domestic financial consumers’ rights.

The new chairman Yeh Chih-chou holds a Ph.D. in law from the University of Freiburg in Germany and has long specialized in civil property law and insurance law, with particular expertise in legal research on financial consumer protection. He has served as a judge, lawyer, and council member of the Consumer Council, and before assuming the chair he was vice dean of the College of Law and director of the Institute of Law at NCCU. The Council noted that Yeh’s extensive experience across government, academia, and legal practice will inject strong professional momentum into the dispute‑resolution mechanism.

Yeh stated that the core value of the financial consumer dispute‑resolution system lies in providing consumers with a fair, professional, convenient, and trustworthy mechanism. Going forward, he will adhere to the principles of “consumer‑centric rights, professional impartiality, and institutional innovation,” continuously refining the council’s procedures and case‑handling quality, while balancing market stability and financial innovation and placing greater emphasis on the substantive rights of financial consumers.

Yeh pointed out that amid rapid changes and development in the financial market, the Council must not only continue to offer a professional, impartial, and efficient dispute‑resolution mechanism but also further strengthen consumer protection, raise the financial services industry’s attention to consumer rights, and improve public financial literacy. In addition, the Council should consolidate various dispute cases to provide professional insights into dispute handling, actively cooperate with supervisory authorities’ policies, and work together to promote a fair and sound development of Taiwan’s financial market and enhance consumer protection measures.

Yeh also expressed special thanks to former chairman Professor Du Yijing for her contributions to the financial consumer dispute‑resolution system and consumer protection during her tenure. The Council will build on the existing framework, continue to enhance the professionalism, fairness, and efficiency of financial consumer dispute handling, and collaborate with regulators, financial service providers, consumer groups, and the broader society to create a more equitable, robust, and trustworthy financial consumer environment.

items.title: 高盛：AI記憶體週期被低估！南韓KOSPI目標12000點、仍有約80%的上漲空間
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: AI Memory Cycle Underestimated! South Korea KOSPI Target 12,000 Points, Still About 80% Upside
paras: 高盛集團一名策略師仍維持對南韓股市的樂觀目標，並表示投資人低估了人工智慧（AI）熱潮對南韓記憶體晶片製造商帶來的提振效應將持續多久。
根據《彭博》報導，該投資銀行亞太區股票策略主管Timothy Moe維持韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）12,000點的目標價，代表較目前水準仍有近80%的上漲空間。
他在3個月前提出這項預估時，該目標價已是華爾街最為樂觀的預測之一。
Moe近日接受採訪時表示，高盛仍維持原先目標，主要依據是企業獲利實際表現。他認為，市場低估了這一輪獲利週期的持續時間。
KOSPI近期表現則與高盛的樂觀看法形成反差。該指數自6月創下的歷史高點回落27%，市場擔憂科技巨頭AI支出的成長能否持續，加上南韓股市波動加劇，即使三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 再度交出亮眼財報，也未能明顯提振股價。
不過，全球爭相興建資料中心，已導致記憶體與儲存晶片出現嚴重短缺，進而推升相關產品價格。Moe預期，這項趨勢到了2027年還將進一步加劇。
他表示，美國大型科技公司明年的支出預估將超過1.2兆美元，遠高於先前預估的8,000億美元。
Moe認為：「即使賺不到錢，也必須持續支出」。他指出：「這對記憶體而言非常有利，因為這將推動運算需求，而運算高度依賴記憶體。」
高盛估計，KOSPI成分股今年獲利將成長約360%，2027年則放緩至約35%。他補充，企業獲利最終將開始放緩，這一點市場其實已經相當清楚。
Moe同時承認，南韓記憶體產業仍面臨中國競爭對手長鑫科技(688825-CN) 等企業帶來的風險，以及美國資料中心擴建可能遭遇政治阻力。
不過，他認為未來幾年基本面仍有利於先進記憶體晶片業者。
在估值方面，Moe的12,000點KOSPI目標，是以未來本益比7.5倍為基礎；目前KOSPI僅約5.3倍，約為過去7年平均值的一半。
Moe表示，如果南韓企業最終能達到高盛預期的獲利水準，那麼12,000點的KOSPI目標，「可能沒有看起來那麼瘋狂」。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Goldman Sachs strategist continues to hold an optimistic outlook for the South Korean stock market, saying investors underestimate how long the AI boom will boost South Korean memory chip makers.

According to Bloomberg, the investment bank’s Asia‑Pacific equity strategy head Timothy Moe maintains a 12,000‑point target for the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI), implying roughly 80% upside from current levels.
When he made the forecast three months ago, that target was among the most bullish on Wall Street.

Moe said in a recent interview that Goldman Sachs still sticks to the original target, basing it mainly on companies’ actual earnings performance, and believes the market is underestimating the duration of this profit cycle.

KOSPI’s recent performance runs counter to Goldman’s optimism, having fallen 27% from its June all‑time high as investors worry whether AI spending by tech giants can be sustained, and heightened volatility in the Korean market has left even strong earnings from Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS) unable to lift the index.
However, a global rush to build data centers has created a severe shortage of memory and storage chips, pushing up prices, and Moe expects the trend to intensify further by 2027.
He noted that U.S. big‑tech firms are projected to spend more than $1.2 trillion next year, far above the previous $800 billion estimate.
Moe said, “Even if you’re not making money, you have to keep spending.” He added, “That’s very favorable for memory because it drives compute demand, and compute heavily relies on memory.”

Goldman estimates that KOSPI constituents’ earnings will grow about 360% this year, slowing to roughly 35% by 2027, and he added that the market already understands that corporate profits will eventually decelerate.
Moe also acknowledged that South Korea’s memory industry faces risks from Chinese rivals such as ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) and possible political resistance to U.S. data‑center expansion.
Nevertheless, he believes fundamentals will remain supportive of advanced memory chip makers over the next few years.
In valuation terms, Moe’s 12,000‑point KOSPI target is based on a forward price‑to‑earnings multiple of 7.5×; the index currently trades at about 5.3×, roughly half its seven‑year average.
Moe said that if South Korean companies ultimately achieve the profit levels Goldman expects, the 12,000‑point KOSPI target “might not look that crazy.”

paras: 共信-KY(6617-TW)旗下動物靶向腫瘤消融新藥「思沛康注射液」(Gwa103)適用於治療犬科黑色素瘤，接獲農業部新藥上市技術資料核准，將啟動產品上市前整備與教育規劃，搶攻寵物癌症市場，激勵共信-KY今(7)日亮燈漲停。
共信-KY旗下思沛康注射液以瘤內藥物消融(IDA)機制來消滅癌細胞，可以選擇性進入癌細胞，降低對正常細胞的傷害，可望降低飼主後續的照護負擔。
共信-KY指出，目前已與全台超過100家動物醫院簽署合作意向書，待完成藥品標示、供應鏈與院所導入作業後，將依法規陸續供貨並展開臨床教育訓練，協助醫療團隊在合規與安全前下提供更多元的治療選擇。
國際布局上，共信-KY表示，美國FDA已核准思沛康注射液具有「有條件核准藥物」資格，也已取得美國臨床許可，將積極規劃美國有條件上市申請，並逐步拓展至澳洲、日本、美國、中國、香港等主要寵物市場。
針對市場現況，共信-KY提到，根據Fortune Business Insights調查顯示，2025年全球獸醫腫瘤市場規模已達29億美元，預估2026年起將以10.7%的年複合成長率(CAGR)快速成長，預估在2034年上看71.1億美元
共信-KY今天跳空漲停，鎖住135元，站上所有均線，排隊委買單近2000張，成交量則約500張。
paras_en: Gung Shin-KY (6617-TW) announced that its animal‑targeted tumor ablation drug "Sipeikang Injection" (Gwa103), indicated for canine melanoma, has received technical data approval for new drug registration from the Ministry of Agriculture. The company will begin pre‑launch preparation and education planning to capture the pet cancer market, prompting Gung Shin‑KY's shares to light up and hit the limit‑up price today (the 7th).

The Sipeikang Injection uses an intratumoral drug ablation (IDA) mechanism to destroy cancer cells. It can selectively enter tumor cells, reducing damage to normal cells and potentially lowering the care burden for pet owners thereafter.

Gung Shin‑KY said it has already signed letters of intent with more than 100 animal hospitals across Taiwan. After completing product labeling, supply‑chain setup, and hospital implementation, the drug will be supplied in compliance with regulations and clinical education training will commence to help medical teams provide more treatment options safely and compliantly.

On the international front, Gung Shin‑KY noted that the U.S. FDA has granted the Sipeikang Injection conditional drug approval status and has secured U.S. clinical permission. The company will actively plan a conditional U.S. market application and gradually expand into major pet markets such as Australia, Japan, the United States, China, and Hong Kong.

Regarding market conditions, Gung Shin‑KY cited a Fortune Business Insights survey showing the global veterinary oncology market will reach $2.9 billion by 2025, with an expected compound annual growth rate of 10.7% starting in 2026, projecting the market to grow to $7.11 billion by 2034.
Gung Shin‑KY’s shares gap‑up to a limit‑up price of NT$135 today, breaking above all moving averages, with nearly 2,000 buy‑order blocks queued and a trading volume of about 500 shares.

items.title: 黃金ETF8月吸金170億美元 WGC揭漲勢主因、美銀喊續抱
items.title_en: Gold ETFs Attract $17 Billion in August; WGC Identifies Main Driver of the Rally, BofA Calls for Continued Buying
paras: 多家媒體報導，黃金8月走高，背後主要推力是投資資金湧入。世界黃金協會 (WGC) 指出，黃金ETF與期貨部位帶動這波行情，美國財政部擴大債券回購只是加速既有漲勢。美國銀行策略師哈特奈特 (Michael Hartnett) 則從政策干預與貨幣貶值避險角度出發，建議投資人持續做多黃金與大宗商品。
現貨黃金8月一度逼近每盎司4,700美元，升至5月中旬以來最高。WGC歐洲、中東及非洲資深分析師Krishan Gopaul 表示，黃金投資需求自7月起增強，全球實體黃金支持的ETF當月淨流入30億美元，終結連續兩個月資金外流，8月淨流入規模進一步擴大至170億美元。
Gopaul指出，期貨部位與黃金ETF資金流入，是近期金價上漲的主要動力，並非實體黃金零售需求突然大增。中國與印度的投資需求也出現較明確改善，實體消費買盤則提供部分支撐。
對於美國財政部擴大債券回購的影響，Gopaul認為，這項消息直到8月底才公布，當時金價已處於上升趨勢。在市場擔憂美國及其他國家債務負擔的背景下，回購消息較可能是讓漲勢加快，而非啟動行情的原因。
央行買盤的角色也需要區分。Gopaul表示，各國央行購金是支撐黃金市場的重要基礎，但難以視為最近數週上漲的直接觸發因素。他預期，今年官方部門購金仍將維持強勁，但規模低於2025年。
相較於WGC著重分析金價上漲的資金來源，Hartnett更關注政策環境。他認為，政策制定者為壓抑債券殖利率而採取的干預已開始奏效，日元走強就是例證之一；央行也傾向透過升息重建政策可信度，防止殖利率急升。
Hartnett 指出，當前政策優先目標是維持名目經濟繁榮與資產價格多頭格局。在此背景下，他主張持續做多大宗商品，以及黃金等可對沖貨幣貶值的資產。美銀報告列出的資金流向顯示，截至9月2日當週，黃金吸金32億美元；同期股票流入28億美元，創9週最低。
不過，看好黃金並不代表漲勢毫無阻力。
Gopaul 提醒，若長期實質殖利率回升、美元轉強，或聯準會 (Fed) 立場比預期更鷹派，都將構成短期壓力。反之，美元走弱、實質殖利率下滑、ETF持續吸金，以及財政與地緣政治風險升高，則有利金價表現。
他認為，整體環境仍對黃金形成支撐，但不確定性與市場波動將持續影響今年剩餘時間的行情。
paras_en: Several media outlets reported that gold rose in August, driven mainly by an influx of investment capital. The World Gold Council (WGC) said that gold ETFs and futures positions propelled the move, while the U.S. Treasury’s expanded bond buyback program merely accelerated an existing uptrend. Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett, looking at policy intervention and currency‑devaluation hedging, advised investors to keep buying gold and commodities.

Spot gold in August briefly approached $4,700 per ounce, the highest level since mid‑May. Krishan Gopaul, a senior analyst for Europe, the Middle East and Africa at the WGC, noted that investment demand for gold has strengthened since July, with physically‑backed ETFs recording a net inflow of $3 billion that month, ending two consecutive months of outflows, and total net inflows expanding to $17 billion in August.

Gopaul pointed out that the inflows into futures positions and gold ETFs are the primary drivers of the recent price rise, not a sudden surge in retail demand for physical gold. Investment demand from China and India also showed a clearer improvement, while consumer buying of physical gold provided some support.

Regarding the impact of the Treasury’s expanded bond buyback, Gopaul said the news was only announced at the end of August, by which time gold was already on an upward trend. In a market worried about debt burdens in the United States and elsewhere, the buyback news likely accelerated the rally rather than initiating it.

The role of central‑bank buying also needs to be distinguished. Gopaul said that purchases by central banks are an important foundation for the gold market, but they cannot be seen as the direct trigger for the recent weeks’ gains. He expects official sector buying to remain strong this year, albeit at a scale lower than in 2025.

While the WGC focuses on the source of capital behind the price rise, Hartnett pays more attention to the policy environment. He believes that policymakers’ interventions aimed at suppressing bond yields are already taking effect, with a stronger yen as one example; central banks are also inclined to rebuild policy credibility through rate hikes to prevent yields from spiking.

Hartnett noted that the current policy priority is to maintain nominal economic growth and a bullish asset‑price environment. In that context, he advocates staying long on commodities and assets like gold that can hedge currency depreciation. Bank of America data showed that in the week ending September 2, gold attracted $3.2 billion of inflows, while equities saw $2.8 billion of inflows, the lowest level in nine weeks.
However, being bullish on gold does not mean the rally is without resistance.

Gopaul warned that a rise in real yields, a stronger dollar, or a more hawkish Federal Reserve stance than expected would create short‑term pressure. Conversely, a weaker dollar, falling real yields, continued ETF inflows, and heightened fiscal and geopolitical risks would benefit gold prices.
He concluded that the overall environment still supports gold, but uncertainty and market volatility will continue to shape the market for the remainder of the year.

items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉瑞昱拿下3奈米ASIC訂單 看好台灣值得投資的兩大關鍵領域
items.title_en: Realtek Wins 3nm ASIC Order, Highlights Two Key Investment Areas for Taiwan
paras: IC設計大廠瑞昱(2379-TW)董事長邱順建今(7)日獲頒第15屆工研院院士，會後受訪表示，瑞昱持續布局先進製程與AI領域，目前ASIC已推進至3奈米製程，並透露持續與輝達(NVDA-TW)及其他國際大廠合作，看好高速傳輸介面與交換器都是台灣IC設計產業未來值得投入的領域。
瑞昱近年在先進製程布局與國際大廠相比略顯保守，不過，此次隨著瑞昱透露已布局3奈米，顯示瑞昱在先進製程的專案已有所進展，進一步往更高階產品延伸。
針對聯發科(2454-TW)先前獲得輝達投資，邱順建認為，聯發科近年與大型科技公司合作發展ASIC客製化晶片的模式，是產業發展「必然的趨勢」，也是台灣IC設計產業升級過程中自然會出現的變化。
邱順建也透露，瑞昱與國際大型科技公司之間的合作並不只有外界目前看到的項目，仍有眾多合作正在進行，只是部分專案涉及客戶保密協議，現階段無法對外說明，未來可能要等產品推出或雙方正式發布消息後，市場才會看見，此外，也指出瑞昱已加入ESUN(Ethernet for Scale-Up Networking)聯盟。
至於是否會仿效其他台灣IC設計公司，引進國際科技大廠策略投資，邱順建表示，投資要看雙方「緣分」，但企業合作與業務發展並不一定要透過股權投資，投資只是加分項，真正關鍵仍在於瑞昱本身能否持續替客戶創造價值。
他指出，過去IC設計業多以開發標準型產品為主，但隨著大型科技公司系統複雜度提高、產品差異化需求增加，客戶自然會產生更多客製化IC需求。透過IC設計公司與客戶共同開發，可加快產品推出速度，也有助整體科技產業快速迭代。
邱順建並透露，瑞昱本身其實早已有零星ASIC業務，只是目前規模沒有聯發科大，至於未來是否擴大，他表示「方向上是這樣」，但ASIC業務必須與客戶高度密切合作，實際規模仍會隨著客戶專案與生意發展逐步擴張。
除了ASIC外，瑞昱也同步強化AI網通相關技術。邱順建點名，高速介面與交換器(Switch)都是台灣IC設計產業未來值得投入的領域。隨著AI伺服器與資料中心規模持續放大，晶片之間、伺服器之間乃至整座資料中心內部的資料交換需求快速增加，也使高速網路與交換器晶片的重要性大幅提升。
邱順建指出，光通訊同樣是瑞昱下階段布局重點，光通訊已成為AI應用非常重要的核心技術，全球業者都在積極投入，瑞昱也正建立相關IP與產品。不過相較全球領先業者，台灣在此領域仍有一定差距，未來幾年將是台灣產業非常重要的布局方向。
在無線網路方面，瑞昱技術演進同樣加快。邱順建表示，公司目前已不只是開發Wi-Fi 8，而是Wi-Fi 8已進入量產階段，研發也持續往下一世代技術推進。
paras_en: Realtek (2379-TW), a major IC design company, had its chairman Qiu Shunjian awarded the 15th Academia of Industrial Technology fellowship today (the 7th). In the interview after the ceremony, he said Realtek continues to focus on advanced processes and AI, with its ASIC now progressing to a 3nm process, and disclosed ongoing collaborations with Nvidia (NVDA-TW) and other global giants, expressing confidence that high‑speed transmission interfaces and switches are future growth areas for Taiwan’s IC design industry.

In recent years Realtek’s advanced‑process rollout has been somewhat cautious compared with other international firms, but its announcement of a 3nm layout shows the company has made progress on advanced‑process projects and is moving toward higher‑end products.

Regarding MediaTek’s (2454-TW) earlier investment by Nvidia, Qiu said MediaTek’s recent partnerships with large tech companies to develop custom ASIC chips represent an "inevitable trend" in the industry and a natural evolution in the upgrade of Taiwan’s IC design sector.

Qiu also revealed that Realtek’s collaborations with major international tech firms extend beyond the projects currently visible to the public; many are ongoing but bound by confidentiality agreements, so details cannot be disclosed until products launch or official announcements are made. He also noted that Realtek has joined the ESUN (Ethernet for Scale‑Up Networking) alliance.

When asked whether Realtek would follow other Taiwanese IC designers in seeking strategic equity investments from global tech giants, Qiu said investment depends on mutual "chemistry," but cooperation and business development do not necessarily require equity stakes—investment is merely a bonus, with the real key being Realtek’s ability to continuously create value for customers.

He pointed out that the IC design industry traditionally focused on standard‑product development, but as large tech companies’ systems become more complex and demand greater product differentiation, customers naturally generate more demand for custom ICs. Joint development between designers and customers can accelerate product rollout and help the broader tech industry iterate faster.

Qiu disclosed that Realtek has already had some scattered ASIC business, though its scale is currently smaller than MediaTek’s. As for future expansion, he said the direction is affirmative, but ASIC work requires close collaboration with customers, so actual scale will grow gradually with project and business development.

Beyond ASICs, Realtek is simultaneously strengthening AI networking technologies. Qiu highlighted that high‑speed interfaces and switches are worthwhile investment areas for Taiwan’s IC design sector. As AI servers and data‑center sizes continue to expand, the demand for data exchange among chips, between servers, and within entire data centers is soaring, greatly raising the importance of high‑speed networking and switch chips.

Qiu noted that optical communications is also a focus of Realtek’s next‑stage strategy. Optical links have become a core technology for AI applications, with global players investing heavily, and Realtek is building related IP and products. However, compared with world leaders, Taiwan still lags in this field, making the coming years a crucial period for Taiwan’s industry to catch up.

In wireless networking, Realtek’s technology evolution is also accelerating. Qiu said the company is no longer just developing Wi‑Fi 8; Wi‑Fi 8 has entered mass production, and R&D is already pushing toward the next‑generation technology.

items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉秦永沛：台積電卓越製造沒有捷徑 近40年靠團隊一步一腳印
items.title_en: TSMC Executive Qin Yong‑pei Named 15th Academician of ITRI: No Shortcut to TSMC’s Manufacturing Excellence, Built Step by Step Over 40 Years
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)執行副總經理暨共同營運長秦永沛今(7)日獲選第15屆工研院院士。他在致詞時表示，工研院長年扮演台灣科技產業「開路先鋒」與人才培育的重要角色，當年正是透過工研院的人才培育與技術轉移，為台積電成立奠定關鍵基礎，也點燃台灣半導體產業走向世界的曙光。
秦永沛表示，今日能獲選工研院院士，對他而言是一份無上的肯定與榮譽。他回顧台灣半導體產業發展指出，台灣今日能在全球半導體產業占有關鍵地位，可說是一部「台灣奇蹟」，而工研院在最關鍵的時刻，為產業茁壯灌溉養分。
他指出，當年工研院透過人才培育與技術轉移，在台積電成立初期提供重要人才基礎，不僅造就今日台積電的成功，也進一步帶動整體台灣半導體產業走向全球。這份連結不只是技術傳承，更是台灣半導體產業走向世界的重要起點。
秦永沛1982年自成功大學電機研究所畢業後，即加入工研院電子所，先後投入品質保證(QA)及研發工作。他表示，電子所提供非常好的學習環境，在前後四年半的時間裡，為他打下半導體職涯的重要基礎。
1987年，秦永沛離開工研院電子所，加入剛成立不久的台積電，成為早期員工之一。回顧近40年的台積電生涯，他強調，半導體的卓越製造與技術研發「沒有捷徑」，台積電能有今日成就，是在歷任董事長包括張忠謀、劉德音，現任董事長魏哲家具有遠見的領導下，以及所有同仁一步一腳印累積而來。
秦永沛表示，在台積電職涯中，長年與營運團隊共同努力，克服無數技術瓶頸，將卓越製造技術進一步轉化為量產實力，並透過大規模穩定製造支撐全球科技創新，這些成就絕對不是任何一個人能夠單獨完成，而是整個團隊長期共同努力的成果。
致詞中，秦永沛特別向台積電創辦人張忠謀致上敬意與感謝。他表示，張忠謀當年以遠見與胸襟創立晶圓代工商業模式，不僅改變全球半導體產業，也在他的職涯中給予最關鍵的啟發與信任。他同時感謝台積電董事長魏哲家、前董事長劉德音及歷年長官的領導與提攜，使營運團隊能持續在全球卓越製造的競爭賽道上全力衝刺。
秦永沛也特別感謝所有曾共同工作的台積電同仁。他表示，正是因為團隊攜手同行，才能一次又一次克服困難，將挑戰轉化為成功，同時持續創造新的製造與技術突破。
展望未來，秦永沛表示，仍將持續為台積電與台灣科技產業貢獻心力，並攜手供應鏈與產業生態系夥伴，共同推動卓越製造與永續發展。
他最後再次感謝工研院，不僅引領他踏入半導體產業，也給予他院士這份最高肯定。不過，秦永沛強調，這份榮譽不應只屬於個人，而應歸屬於台積電整個營運團隊，以及近40年來每一位堅守崗位的台積人。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Qin Yong‑pei was selected today (the 7th) as a 15th‑session Academician of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). In his remarks he said ITRI has long played a pioneering role and a key talent‑development function for Taiwan’s tech industry; it was through ITRI’s talent cultivation and technology transfer that the foundation for TSMC’s founding was laid, igniting the dawn of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry on the world stage.

Qin said being chosen as an ITRI Academician is the highest affirmation and honor for him. He reflected on the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, noting that Taiwan’s current pivotal position in the global semiconductor arena is a “Taiwan miracle,” and that ITRI supplied essential nourishment to the industry at its most critical moments.

He pointed out that, back then, ITRI’s talent training and technology transfer provided a vital talent base during TSMC’s early days, not only creating today’s TSMC success but also propelling the entire Taiwanese semiconductor industry worldwide. This link is more than a technical hand‑over; it is the crucial starting point for Taiwan’s semiconductor industry to go global.

Qin graduated in 1982 from the Electrical Engineering Graduate Institute of National Cheng Kung University and immediately joined ITRI’s Electronics Institute, working in quality assurance (QA) and R&D. He said the Electronics Institute offered an excellent learning environment and, over four and a half years, laid the foundation for his semiconductor career.

In 1987 Qin left ITRI’s Electronics Institute to join the newly founded TSMC, becoming one of its early employees. Looking back on nearly 40 years at TSMC, he emphasized that there is “no shortcut” to excellence in semiconductor manufacturing and R&D; TSMC’s achievements stem from the visionary leadership of successive chairmen—including Morris Chang, Dr. Liu De‑yin, and current chairman Dr. Wei Zhe‑jia—and the steady, step‑by‑step contributions of all colleagues.

Qin noted that throughout his TSMC career he has worked closely with the operations team to overcome countless technical bottlenecks, turning manufacturing excellence into mass‑production capability and supporting global tech innovation with large‑scale, stable production. These accomplishments are the result of long‑term collective effort, not any single individual’s work.

In his speech Qin paid special tribute to TSMC founder Morris Chang, thanking him for establishing the foundry business model with vision and generosity, which reshaped the global semiconductor industry and gave Qin the most critical inspiration and trust in his career. He also thanked Chairman Wei Zhe‑jia, former chairman Liu De‑yin, and past leaders for their guidance that enabled the operations team to sprint full‑throttle on the global excellence‑manufacturing race track.

Qin also expressed gratitude to all TSMC colleagues he has worked with, saying that it is the teamwork that has repeatedly overcome difficulties, turning challenges into successes while continuously creating new manufacturing and technology breakthroughs.

Looking ahead, Qin said he will continue to devote his energy to TSMC and Taiwan’s technology industry, collaborating with the supply chain and ecosystem partners to jointly advance manufacturing excellence and sustainable development.

He concluded by thanking ITRI again for leading him into the semiconductor field and granting him the highest honor of Academician. However, Qin stressed that this honor belongs not to an individual but to the entire TSMC operations team and every TSMC employee who has steadfastly served over the past four decades.

items.title: 金融消費評議中心完成董監事改選 杜怡靜卸任、葉啓洲接任董事長
items.title_en: Financial Consumer Council Completes Board and Supervisor Election; Du Yijing Steps Down, Yeh Chih-chou Assumes Chairmanship
paras: 財團法人金融消費評議中心今(7)日召開第六屆第一次董事及監察人會議，會中順利完成交接，由國立政治大學法學院特聘教授葉啓洲接替卸任的杜怡靜教授，出任新任董事長，並於同日正式就職。葉啓洲兼具法官、律師實務背景與深厚學術功底，他表示，未來將以「公平、專業、便利」為核心，持續精進金融爭議處理品質，深化國內金融消費者權益保障。
新任董事長葉啓洲為德國弗萊堡大學法學博士，長期深耕民事財產法與保險法領域，並專精金融消費者保護相關法制研究。他曾任法官、律師及評議中心評議委員，接任前為政大法學院副院長暨法科所所長。評議中心指出，葉啓洲橫跨產官學界與法務實務的豐沛能量，將為爭議解決機制注入強大專業動能。
葉啓洲表示，金融消費評議制度的核心價值，在於提供消費者一個公平、專業、便利且值得信賴的爭議解決機制。未來將秉持「以消費者權益為核心、以專業公正為基礎、以制度創新為動力」的原則，持續精進評議制度與案件處理品質，在兼顧金融市場穩定與金融創新的同時，更加重視金融消費者的實質權益。
葉啓洲指出，面對金融市場的快速變化及發展，評議中心除持續提供專業、公正及有效率的爭議處理機制外，須進一步強化金融消費者保護、提升金融服務業對消費者權益的重視及有效提升民眾的金融素養，同時，應綜整各種紛爭案例，提供相關爭議處理之專業洞察並積極配合監理機關相關施政政策，一同攜手促進我國金融市場公平與健全發展及強化我國消費者保護措施。
此外，葉啓洲也特別感謝前任董事長杜怡靜教授任內對金融消費爭議處理制度及消費者保護工作的投入與貢獻。評議中心將延續既有制度基礎，持續提升金融消費爭議處理的專業性、公平性及效率，並與主管機關、金融服務業、消費者團體及社會各界共同努力，建立更加公平、健全且值得信賴的金融消費環境。
paras_en: The Financial Consumer Council held its first board and supervisor meeting of the sixth term today (the 7th), successfully completing the handover. Professor Yeh Chih-chou, a distinguished professor at the College of Law, National Chengchi University, succeeded the outgoing Professor Du Yijing as the new chairman and was formally inaugurated on the same day. Yeh, who brings both judicial and legal practice experience as well as strong academic credentials, said he will focus on “fairness, professionalism, and convenience” as core principles, continuously improving the quality of financial dispute resolution and deepening protection of domestic financial consumers’ rights.

The new chairman Yeh Chih-chou holds a Ph.D. in law from the University of Freiburg in Germany and has long specialized in civil property law and insurance law, with particular expertise in legal research on financial consumer protection. He has served as a judge, lawyer, and council member of the Consumer Council, and before assuming the chair he was vice dean of the College of Law and director of the Institute of Law at NCCU. The Council noted that Yeh’s extensive experience across government, academia, and legal practice will inject strong professional momentum into the dispute‑resolution mechanism.

Yeh stated that the core value of the financial consumer dispute‑resolution system lies in providing consumers with a fair, professional, convenient, and trustworthy mechanism. Going forward, he will adhere to the principles of “consumer‑centric rights, professional impartiality, and institutional innovation,” continuously refining the council’s procedures and case‑handling quality, while balancing market stability and financial innovation and placing greater emphasis on the substantive rights of financial consumers.

Yeh pointed out that amid rapid changes and development in the financial market, the Council must not only continue to offer a professional, impartial, and efficient dispute‑resolution mechanism but also further strengthen consumer protection, raise the financial services industry’s attention to consumer rights, and improve public financial literacy. In addition, the Council should consolidate various dispute cases to provide professional insights into dispute handling, actively cooperate with supervisory authorities’ policies, and work together to promote a fair and sound development of Taiwan’s financial market and enhance consumer protection measures.

Yeh also expressed special thanks to former chairman Professor Du Yijing for her contributions to the financial consumer dispute‑resolution system and consumer protection during her tenure. The Council will build on the existing framework, continue to enhance the professionalism, fairness, and efficiency of financial consumer dispute handling, and collaborate with regulators, financial service providers, consumer groups, and the broader society to create a more equitable, robust, and trustworthy financial consumer environment.

items.title: 漢測9月22日上櫃！毛利率衝54.88%、AI測試需求爆發，從工程服務走向高毛利解決方案
paras:
漢測9月22日掛牌！承銷價2250元，寫下台股IPO新高
漢測(7856-TWO)目前仍屬興櫃公司，並於2025年9月17日正式登錄興櫃，股票代號為7856。公司預計在2026年9月22日掛牌上櫃，正式邁入資本市場新階段。
此次上櫃前公開承銷，競價拍賣期間為9月7日至9日，競拍數量4,192張、最低投標價格1,800元；公開申購則於9月10日至14日進行，承銷價暫定每股2,250元，9月16日抽籤，9月22日掛牌。
2,250元的暫定承銷價，也創下台股IPO史上最高承銷價紀錄。漢測近期股價與掛牌話題受到市場高度關注，不過對投資人而言，真正值得觀察的仍是掛牌後能否延續AI測試需求帶來的營運成長。

漢測毛利率從36%衝到54.88%！產品組合升級成最大關鍵
漢測這幾年的變化，最直接反映在獲利率。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
2024年漢測毛利率為36.23%，2025年提升至42.10%，2026年上半年進一步攀升至54.88%；營業利益率則從2024年的3.35%，一路提高至2025年的12.23%，今年上半年更達33.59%。這代表漢測近年的成長不只是「營收變多」，更重要的是高附加價值產品占比快速提高。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
目前漢測主要有三大業務，包括探針卡與清潔材料、測試設備工程服務，以及半導體設備與客製化產品。漢測從早期設備工程服務起家，營收結構已產生質變。2026 年第一季客製化產品與代理設備占比達58%、工程服務約23%、探針卡與清潔材料約19%，半導體設備與客製化產品已取代工程服務，成為營收占比最高的核心業務，帶動毛利率大幅提升。

AI晶片越來越熱，漢測靠「熱管理」切進高功耗測試市場
AI與HPC晶片持續提高算力與功耗，也讓晶圓測試階段的熱管理問題更加受到重視。
漢測目前推出探針卡氣冷熱管理模組，透過乾燥空氣直接吹向探針卡，將測試環境維持在適當溫度；下半年還將推出加入冷凍機的低溫乾燥氣冷方案，進一步提升散熱能力。
這項產品目前已成為漢測重要成長動能。公開資訊顯示，熱管理相關產品占今年上半年營收比重已超過三成，客戶備料需求能見度也延伸至2027年中旬，公司預期該業務明年營收有機會較今年倍增。
換句話說，AI帶來的不只是晶片需求增加，也正在創造新的測試環境、散熱與設備需求，而漢測正好卡位這個市場。

探針卡訂單能見度高！2027年產能拚增一倍
除了熱管理，探針卡仍是漢測的重要成長支柱。
目前公司產品涵蓋薄膜式、懸臂式、垂直式Cobra及MEMS探針卡。其中，薄膜式探針卡為台灣自主製造，垂直式Cobra探針卡也在台灣製造；MEMS探針卡則與日本MJC合作開發，最快預計2028年貢獻營收。
其中，垂直式探針卡近期能見度相當高，公司表示受惠IPC及IPD相關訂單增加，目前正積極擴充設備組裝、人力與自動化能力，目標2027年探針卡產能較2026年增加一倍。
此外，在缺工、缺料與產能吃緊的產業環境下，漢測近期也與部分客戶進行價格調整，部分產品預計自2026年9月起生效，漲幅達雙位數百分比，若順利反映至產品價格，也有助於支撐毛利率表現。

矽光子、CoWoS、記憶體測試全都布局！下一階段成長在哪？
漢測的野心並不只在探針卡與熱管理。
公司目前也積極布局高速記憶體SLT、CoWoS先進封裝設備，以及矽光子測試，希望從傳統測試工程服務進一步延伸至更完整的測試解決方案。
其中矽光子是市場近期關注的另一項新題材。
漢測目前已建立Insertion 1自有解決方案，Insertion 2、3則與德國Ficontec合作，從原先的工程服務逐步延伸至ODM、OEM設備。公司預期2027年矽光子測試將進一步提高自動化程度，相關設備營收也可望逐步增加；目前公司預估矽光子測試方案最快2027年開始有較明顯營收貢獻。
不過，矽光子目前仍處於市場導入及驗證階段，真正大量放量的時間點仍需觀察。公司對產業的看法是，2026、2027年仍以少量需求為主，2028年才有機會進入較大規模量產。

前7月營收已超越2025全年！漢測AI測試成長還沒走完
從營收表現來看，漢測2026年成長速度更加明顯。
2026年前7月累計營收達26.68億元，年增128.18%，不僅大幅高於去年同期，更已超越2025年全年24.25億元的營收。
上半年營收21.85億元、年增114.5%，稅後淨利5.84億元、年增389.37%，EPS達21.5元，營收與獲利同步創下同期新高。
因此，漢測目前最大的變化已經不是單純「工程服務做得更多」，而是AI、高效能運算帶動測試需求升級，進一步推動公司產品組合往熱管理、探針卡、先進封裝及矽光子等高附加價值領域移動。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

漢測快速成長背後，仍有三大風險要留意
不過，漢測營運快速成長的同時，也有幾項風險需要留意。
第一，客戶集中度仍是重要觀察點。公司部分主要客戶占營收比重較高，若個別客戶資本支出或訂單需求出現變化，可能對短期營收造成影響。
第二，新產品仍需要時間放量。MEMS探針卡最快2028年才有望貢獻營收，而矽光子目前仍處於導入、驗證階段，短期營收貢獻相對有限。
第三，掛牌後市場評價已反映部分成長預期。漢測此次暫定承銷價2,250元創下台股IPO新高，興櫃股價近期也維持高檔，因此正式上櫃後，市場除了看營收成長，更會檢視高毛利產品能否持續放量，以及目前高獲利率是否能維持。

paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今天公告2026年8月營收為新台幣9,217.66億元，年增率51.98%，月增率-2.61%。
今年1-8月累計營收為6.51兆元，累計年增率39.73%。
最新價為256元，近5日股價上漲1.19%，相關其他電子上漲0.37%，短期股價無明顯表現。

鴻海(2317-TW) 所屬產業為其他電子業，主要業務為電腦系統設備及其週邊之連接器等。線纜組件及殼體,基座之開發、。設計、製造及銷售等。精密模具之製造及銷售等。
