paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue was NT$921.766 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 51.98% and a month‑over‑month decline of 2.61%.
For the year‑to‑date January‑August period, cumulative revenue reached NT$6.51 trillion, up 39.73% year‑over‑year.
The latest share price is NT$256, with the stock up 1.19% over the past five trading days, while the related other electronics sector rose 0.37%; there is no clear short‑term price trend.
Recent five‑day shareholding.

Net buying by the three major institutional investors: +28,424 lots; foreign investors: +25,285 lots; investment trusts: +1,976 lots; proprietary traders: +1,163 lots. Revenue overview for the past six months.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) belongs to the “Other Electronics” industry, primarily engaged in computer system equipment and related connectors, cable assemblies and housings, base development, design, manufacturing and sales, as well as precision mold manufacturing and sales.
Note: Data are for reference only and do not constitute investment advice.

items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉秦永沛：台積電卓越製造沒有捷徑 近40年靠團隊一步一腳印
items.title_en: TSMC Executive Qin Yong‑pei Named 15th Academician of ITRI: No Shortcut to TSMC’s Manufacturing Excellence, Built Step by Step Over 40 Years
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)執行副總經理暨共同營運長秦永沛今(7)日獲選第15屆工研院院士。他在致詞時表示，工研院長年扮演台灣科技產業「開路先鋒」與人才培育的重要角色，當年正是透過工研院的人才培育與技術轉移，為台積電成立奠定關鍵基礎，也點燃台灣半導體產業走向世界的曙光。
秦永沛表示，今日能獲選工研院院士，對他而言是一份無上的肯定與榮譽。他回顧台灣半導體產業發展指出，台灣今日能在全球半導體產業占有關鍵地位，可說是一部「台灣奇蹟」，而工研院在最關鍵的時刻，為產業茁壯灌溉養分。
他指出，當年工研院透過人才培育與技術轉移，在台積電成立初期提供重要人才基礎，不僅造就今日台積電的成功，也進一步帶動整體台灣半導體產業走向全球。這份連結不只是技術傳承，更是台灣半導體產業走向世界的重要起點。
秦永沛1982年自成功大學電機研究所畢業後，即加入工研院電子所，先後投入品質保證(QA)及研發工作。他表示，電子所提供非常好的學習環境，在前後四年半的時間裡，為他打下半導體職涯的重要基礎。
1987年，秦永沛離開工研院電子所，加入剛成立不久的台積電，成為早期員工之一。回顧近40年的台積電生涯，他強調，半導體的卓越製造與技術研發「沒有捷徑」，台積電能有今日成就，是在歷任董事長包括張忠謀、劉德音，現任董事長魏哲家具有遠見的領導下，以及所有同仁一步一腳印累積而來。
秦永沛表示，在台積電職涯中，長年與營運團隊共同努力，克服無數技術瓶頸，將卓越製造技術進一步轉化為量產實力，並透過大規模穩定製造支撐全球科技創新，這些成就絕對不是任何一個人能夠單獨完成，而是整個團隊長期共同努力的成果。
致詞中，秦永沛特別向台積電創辦人張忠謀致上敬意與感謝。他表示，張忠謀當年以遠見與胸襟創立晶圓代工商業模式，不僅改變全球半導體產業，也在他的職涯中給予最關鍵的啟發與信任。他同時感謝台積電董事長魏哲家、前董事長劉德音及歷年長官的領導與提攜，使營運團隊能持續在全球卓越製造的競爭賽道上全力衝刺。
秦永沛也特別感謝所有曾共同工作的台積電同仁。他表示，正是因為團隊攜手同行，才能一次又一次克服困難，將挑戰轉化為成功，同時持續創造新的製造與技術突破。
展望未來，秦永沛表示，仍將持續為台積電與台灣科技產業貢獻心力，並攜手供應鏈與產業生態系夥伴，共同推動卓越製造與永續發展。
他最後再次感謝工研院，不僅引領他踏入半導體產業，也給予他院士這份最高肯定。不過，秦永沛強調，這份榮譽不應只屬於個人，而應歸屬於台積電整個營運團隊，以及近40年來每一位堅守崗位的台積人。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Qin Yong‑pei was selected today (the 7th) as a 15th‑session Academician of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). In his remarks he said ITRI has long played a pioneering role and a key talent‑development function for Taiwan’s tech industry; it was through ITRI’s talent cultivation and technology transfer that the foundation for TSMC’s founding was laid, igniting the dawn of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry on the world stage.

Qin said being chosen as an ITRI Academician is the highest affirmation and honor for him. He reflected on the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, noting that Taiwan’s current pivotal position in the global semiconductor arena is a “Taiwan miracle,” and that ITRI supplied essential nourishment to the industry at its most critical moments.

He pointed out that, back then, ITRI’s talent training and technology transfer provided a vital talent base during TSMC’s early days, not only creating today’s TSMC success but also propelling the entire Taiwanese semiconductor industry worldwide. This link is more than a technical hand‑over; it is the crucial starting point for Taiwan’s semiconductor industry to go global.

Qin graduated in 1982 from the Electrical Engineering Graduate Institute of National Cheng Kung University and immediately joined ITRI’s Electronics Institute, working in quality assurance (QA) and R&D. He said the Electronics Institute offered an excellent learning environment and, over four and a half years, laid the foundation for his semiconductor career.

In 1987 Qin left ITRI’s Electronics Institute to join the newly founded TSMC, becoming one of its early employees. Looking back on nearly 40 years at TSMC, he emphasized that there is “no shortcut” to excellence in semiconductor manufacturing and R&D; TSMC’s achievements stem from the visionary leadership of successive chairmen—including Morris Chang, Dr. Liu De‑yin, and current chairman Dr. Wei Zhe‑jia—and the steady, step‑by‑step contributions of all colleagues.

Qin noted that throughout his TSMC career he has worked closely with the operations team to overcome countless technical bottlenecks, turning manufacturing excellence into mass‑production capability and supporting global tech innovation with large‑scale, stable production. These accomplishments are the result of long‑term collective effort, not any single individual’s work.

In his speech Qin paid special tribute to TSMC founder Morris Chang, thanking him for establishing the foundry business model with vision and generosity, which reshaped the global semiconductor industry and gave Qin the most critical inspiration and trust in his career. He also thanked Chairman Wei Zhe‑jia, former chairman Liu De‑yin, and past leaders for their guidance that enabled the operations team to sprint full‑throttle on the global excellence‑manufacturing race track.

Qin also expressed gratitude to all TSMC colleagues he has worked with, saying that it is the teamwork that has repeatedly overcome difficulties, turning challenges into successes while continuously creating new manufacturing and technology breakthroughs.

Looking ahead, Qin said he will continue to devote his energy to TSMC and Taiwan’s technology industry, collaborating with the supply chain and ecosystem partners to jointly advance manufacturing excellence and sustainable development.

He concluded by thanking ITRI again for leading him into the semiconductor field and granting him the highest honor of Academician. However, Qin stressed that this honor belongs not to an individual but to the entire TSMC operations team and every TSMC employee who has steadfastly served over the past four decades.

items.title: 黃仁勳宣告「AGI已經到來」！OpenAI GPT-6 Astra訓練動用逾10萬套輝達系統
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Declares “AGI Has Arrived”! OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra Trained Using Over 100,000 NVIDIA Systems
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳表示，通用人工智慧（AGI）時代已經到來，並將OpenAI最新模型GPT-6 Astra的推出，視為人工智慧（AI）系統快速發展的重要里程碑。
根據《Investing.com》報導，黃仁勳週日（6日）在社群平台X發文祝賀OpenAI推出Astra，並直言：「AGI已經到來。」
OpenAI則將Astra形容為目前最具智慧且最「對齊」的AI系統，在電腦操作、軟體工程、網路安全、科學研究及專業工作等領域均展現領先表現。
黃仁勳指出，Astra的訓練使用超過10萬套輝達Grace Blackwell NVLink72系統，凸顯開發尖端AI模型所需的龐大運算資源。
他表示，從ChatGPT到o1，再到Astra，OpenAI僅花了4年時間，並透露接下來將有40萬顆GPU陸續投入運作。
OpenAI總裁布洛克曼（Greg Brockman）同樣曾表示，Astra可能象徵AGI時代的開端。不過，AGI目前並沒有全球一致認可的明確定義。
在性能測試方面，OpenAI表示，Astra在FrontierMath Tier 4取得98%分數，在ARC-AGI-3達到99.9%，並在ExploitBench測試中取得100%的成績。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang said the era of artificial general intelligence (AGI) has arrived and called the launch of OpenAI’s latest model, GPT‑6 Astra, a major milestone in the rapid development of AI systems.
According to Investing.com, Huang posted on X on Sunday the 6th to congratulate OpenAI on releasing Astra and stated plainly, “AGI has arrived.”

OpenAI describes Astra as the most intelligent and most “aligned” AI system to date, showing leading performance across computer operation, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific research, and professional work.
Huang noted that Astra’s training employed more than 100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink‑72 systems, underscoring the massive compute resources required to develop cutting‑edge AI models.
He said that moving from ChatGPT to o1 and now to Astra took OpenAI only four years, and revealed that 400,000 GPUs will be rolled out gradually in the near future.
OpenAI President Greg Brockman also said Astra could mark the beginning of the AGI era, though there is still no globally accepted, precise definition of AGI at present.
In performance testing, OpenAI reported that Astra scored 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, achieved 99.9% on ARC‑AGI‑3, and attained a perfect 100% on the ExploitBench benchmark.

items.title: 蘋果、華為、小米拚場 折疊機本周集中亮相
items.title_en: Apple, Huawei, Xiaomi Battle It Out as Foldable Phones Debut This Week
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 、華為、小米(01810-HK) 拚場，本月7日下午至10日凌晨，華為、小米、蘋果將接連發布各自折疊旗艦手機。
華為定9月7日14時30分召開HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2及全場景新品發表會，主角為第二代三折疊Mate XT 2非凡大師。
同日晚間7時，小米將舉辦秋季旗艦發表會，推出旗下首款「闊折疊」旗艦小米18 Fold。
蘋果將在當地時間9月9日（台灣時間9月10日凌晨1時）舉行秋季新品發表會，這也是特納斯（John Ternus）接任執行長後首場產品發表會。
最大懸念自然是蘋果傳聞已久的首款折疊iPhone，同時iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max等高階機型也會同步亮相。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US), Huawei and Xiaomi (01810-HK) are gearing up for a showdown, with Huawei, Xiaomi and Apple set to unveil their respective flagship foldable phones between the afternoon of the 7th and the early hours of the 10th of this month.

Huawei will hold a HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 and all‑scenario new‑product launch at 14:30 on September 7, featuring the second‑generation three‑fold Mate XT 2 “Extraordinary Master” as the star of the show.
That same evening at 19:00, Xiaomi will host its autumn flagship launch, introducing its first “wide‑fold” flagship, the Xiaomi 18 Fold.
Apple will hold its autumn product launch at 01:00 Taiwan time on September 10 (local time September 9), marking the first product event since John Ternus took over as CEO.
The biggest question mark is the long‑rumored first foldable iPhone, which is expected to be unveiled alongside high‑end models such as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

items.title: 亞馬遜貨機降落時出事 衝出跑道 至少5人死亡
items.title_en: Amazon Cargo Plane Crashes on Landing, Veers Off Runway, At Least 5 Dead
paras: 美國邁阿密國際機場6日（周日）發生一起貨機事故，一架亞馬遜(AMZN-US) Prime Air貨機降落時衝出跑道，撞上地面多輛車輛，造成至少5人死亡、5人受傷，其中3人傷勢危重。
據《路透社》報導，這架Prime Air 7598航班當天14時左右降落邁阿密國際機場，衝出機場一條斜向跑道，撞上地面多輛車輛。事故發生後，機場關閉全部跑道和滑行道。
美國交通部長肖恩·達菲表示，機場關閉可能造成大量延誤和航班取消，提醒旅客做好出行受影響的準備。
美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）證實，涉事飛機為一架波音767-300型貨機，事發前從波多黎各聖胡安起飛。亞馬遜表示，這架飛機由貨運航空公司21 Air負責營運。
《路透社》發布的現場照片顯示，飛機機頭著地，機尾翹起，機身右側出現疑似燒焦痕跡。
亞馬遜發言人凱莉·南特爾表示，仍在了解事故具體情況，並與當地政府和相關部門合作調查。她說，目前最重要的是確保所有涉事人員安全。
目前事故原因尚未公布。美國聯邦航空管理局表示，將對這起事故展開調查。
邁阿密-戴德縣航空部門此前確認機場發生事故。當地消防救援部門表示，有多名傷者被送往救治。
paras_en: On Sunday, June 6, a cargo aircraft operated by Amazon (AMZN-US) Prime Air experienced an accident at Miami International Airport in the United States. The plane burst off the runway during landing and struck several vehicles on the ground, killing at least five people and injuring five others, three of whom are in critical condition.

According to Reuters, the Prime Air Flight 7598 landed at roughly 14:00 at Miami International Airport and then veered onto a diagonal taxiway, colliding with multiple ground vehicles. After the incident, the airport shut down all runways and taxiways.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy warned that the airport closure could cause widespread delays and flight cancellations, urging travelers to prepare for possible disruptions to their journeys.

The Federal Aviation Administration confirmed that the aircraft involved was a Boeing 767‑300 cargo plane that had taken off from San Juan, Puerto Rico. Amazon said the flight was operated by cargo carrier 21 Air.
Photos released by Reuters show the aircraft’s nose on the ground with the tail lifted, and apparent scorch marks on the right side of the fuselage.

Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nanter explained that the company is still gathering details about the crash and is cooperating with local authorities and relevant agencies in the investigation. She emphasized that the top priority is ensuring the safety of everyone involved.
The cause of the accident has not yet been released. The FAA said it will launch an investigation into the incident.
Miami‑Dade County’s aviation department had previously confirmed the accident at the airport. Local fire‑rescue services reported that multiple injured persons were transported for medical treatment.

items.title: AI多頭等待的突破終於來了？高盛：OpenAI Astra模型「脫穎而出」
paras: OpenAI新一代Astra模型橫空出世，市場重新燃起對AI「智慧突破」的期待，高盛更認為，若模型能力持續大幅躍升，AI產業可能迎來新一輪需求擴張，進一步延長資本支出週期；然而，在軟銀、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等相關個股率先上漲之際，日元升值、能源供應風險與聯準會（Fed）即將公布的CPI數據，仍可能成為這波AI樂觀情緒能否延續的關鍵考驗。
高盛Delta One交易台主管Rich Privorotsky在最新市場簡報中指出，Astra的表現具有重大意義，模型能力明顯領先同業，這類實質性的「智慧突破」正是AI多頭長期等待的訊號。
市場也迅速反映這項消息。OpenAI重要投資者軟銀股價隔夜大漲逾10%，由於軟銀持有OpenAI投資部位，其股價經常被視為OpenAI估值變化的市場映射；甲骨文股價也上漲約5.5%。
不過，Privorotsky認為，相關個股上漲反而不是這次事件最值得關注的部分。真正重要的是，如果AI模型能力持續出現跨越式進展，可能重新擴大企業可開發的應用範圍，進而支撐整體AI支出週期。

模型變便宜與模型變聰明，是兩回事

Privorotsky特別區分AI模型「降價」與「能力提升」對市場需求帶來的不同影響。
如果只是token價格下降，企業主要是以更低成本使用既有的AI能力；但若模型本身出現實質性的智慧躍升，企業將可能開始開發過去因技術限制而無法實現的新應用，AI需求曲線也會因此重新擴張。
他指出，真正的智慧突破不僅會改變需求，也會迫使其他AI實驗室持續追趕，進一步維持整個產業的支出動能，並強化市場對「仍有更好的AI應用值得開發」的預期。
Privorotsky也針對先前「token需求增速可能追不上token成本下降」的觀點進一步說明。他認為，只有在模型能力沒有出現根本性進步的情況下，算力供給過剩才可能成為問題；Astra的出現則顯示，目前市場可能正朝另一個方向發展。

OpenAI喊「代際飛躍」 AI競爭轉向智能能力

Astra在部分與AGI相關的基準測試中展現強勁表現，也讓OpenAI對模型能力給出高度評價。
OpenAI總裁Greg Brockman形容Astra可能成為AGI發展的重要節點。面對Astra是否已符合AGI定義的問題，他則直接表示：「我認為就是這個模型。」
不過，目前業界對AGI仍沒有統一的定義與標準化測試方式，Brockman也指出，最終仍應由使用者來判斷。
分析指出，這也反映AI產業競爭正在發生變化。市場競爭不再只是圍繞模型價格與運算效率，而是逐步轉向模型「智慧」本身的較量。
對AI多頭而言，如果模型領先優勢能持續透過能力提升體現，將有助於重新建立市場對AI資本支出週期延續性的信心。

日元走強 日銀升息預期與財政擴張同時出現

除了AI題材之外，Privorotsky也將焦點放在日元走勢。
近期日元持續走強，但目前尚未看到明顯的市場干預跡象；另一方面，市場對日本央行（BOJ）的政策預期轉向更為鷹派，目前已反映9月升息幅度略高於25個基點，以及未來一年累計升息接近100個基點的預期。
與貨幣政策收緊形成對比的是，日本財政政策仍在擴張。Privorotsky指出，日本2027財年預算申請總額已達143.1兆日元。
財政擴張與貨幣緊縮同時存在，加上日元升值，形成目前日本市場值得關注的政策組合。日元升值可能對出口商造成壓力，但日本銀行股則可能持續受惠，Topix銀行指數已升至今年高點。
此外，日元升值也可能削弱市場上的套息交易，進而對全球風險資產構成壓力。

能源供應風險仍是市場最大變數

相較於AI帶來的樂觀情緒，能源市場仍是Privorotsky認為最需要關注的宏觀風險。
荷姆茲海峽航運目前仍受到嚴重干擾。雖然美國已證明能夠護航大型原油船隊通過海峽，但更廣泛的供應問題仍未獲得解決，成品油與液化天然氣（LNG）運輸依然受到阻礙，庫存也持續承受壓力。
Privorotsky認為，目前的供應狀態難以長期維持，因此能源價格仍可能成為市場風險偏好最大的干擾因素。
他也警告，周末期間中東局勢可能出現新的升級或降溫變化；另一方面，隨著美國國內政治因素的重要性提高，未來也可能出現推動中東局勢緩和的機會。
俄烏局勢近期也出現一些外交層面的正面訊號，但Privorotsky認為，市場目前仍不宜對和平前景抱持過高期待。

聯準會等待CPI AI樂觀情緒面臨宏觀數據考驗

在美國貨幣政策方面，市場正逐步尋找聯準會維持利率不變的可能路徑。此前聯準會官員沃勒（Christopher Waller）的言論也顯示，決策核心目前並未出現明顯政策轉向，後續仍將取決於經濟數據。
因此，市場焦點已逐漸從就業數據轉向下周公布的消費者物價指數（CPI）。
經歷8月市場震盪後，投資人持倉已經有所下降，先前表現不佳的共識交易與動能交易也有所降溫。
Privorotsky認為，只要CPI沒有出現明顯的上行意外，風險資產仍存在進一步走強的空間。在這種情況下，Astra所重新點燃的AI投資敘事，也可能成為市場新的推動力量。
接下來市場將迎來甲骨文財報，以及一系列科技產業會議。投資人將從雲端基礎設施與AI業務等領域尋找更多訊號，觀察模型能力突破能否進一步轉化為產業需求與資本支出。
不過，能源價格仍是市場必須留意的主要風險，德國薩克森－安哈特邦周末舉行的選舉同樣受到關注。

items.title: Anthropic掛牌倒數 多檔槓桿ETF蓄勢待發 連Claude都建議別碰
items.title_en: Anthropic Nears IPO Countdown, Multiple Leveraged ETFs Poised, Even Claude Advises Against It
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic可能還要數週才會上市，但基金業者已摩拳擦掌，準備推出個股ETF，讓投資人放大押注這家AI公司的股價表現。
Claude開發商Anthropic已祕密遞交首次公開募股（IPO）申請，預計未來幾週內正式提交公開文件。這意味Anthropic股票最快可能於本月稍晚或10月掛牌交易，屆時投資人將有多檔個股ETF可供選擇，押注這檔AI新股。
不過，策略師甚至AI本身都警告，這類產品波動劇烈，投資人必須具備極高的風險承受能力，並不適合採取長期買進持有策略。
多家基金業者布局槓桿產品
Direxion、Tradr、Leverage Shares及GraniteShares等基金公司，均已公布計畫，準備在Anthropic股票開始交易後不久，推出與其掛鉤的槓桿ETF。REX Shares與Tuttle Capital Management也早在今年3月申請推出純做多的Anthropic ETF。
槓桿型個股ETF透過選擇權、交換合約及期貨等衍生性金融商品，放大所追蹤個股或指數的每日漲跌幅，常見產品為2倍槓桿。
例如，若某檔股票單日上漲2%，其2倍做多ETF理論上應上漲4%；相反地，2倍放空或反向ETF則應下跌4%。若該股票下跌2%，2倍反向ETF理論上則會上漲4%。
這類產品聽起來風險很高，事實也確實如此。當被問及個股ETF整體而言是否安全時，Anthropic旗下Claude給出的回答相當直接。
Claude表示：「簡短答案是：不安全。」它並指出，個別公司的所有特有風險，包括財報不如預期、訴訟及執行長爭議等，都會被槓桿進一步放大。
Claude還表示，由於每日槓桿會產生複利效應，這類產品通常是為短線交易設計，而非供投資人長期買進持有。
每日重設恐使報酬偏離預期
這項提醒完全切中要點。推出相關產品的基金公司均謹慎說明，槓桿ETF會每日重設，因此容易受到短期波動影響。換句話說，當標的股票持續上漲時，做多ETF的長期漲幅可能不如投資人預期；若股價一路走高，反向ETF的跌幅則可能遠超想像。
以GraniteShares 2倍做多輝達(NVDA-US) 每日ETF為例，該基金今年來上漲28.6%，並未達到輝達2026年迄今23.5%漲幅的兩倍。另一方面，GraniteShares 2倍放空輝達每日ETF今年已暴跌近50%。
提出警告的也不只有Claude。市場專家同樣認為，個股ETF並非一般投資人可以輕易承受的產品。
晨星北美ETF與被動式策略研究主管Bryan Armour近期在報告中形容，個股ETF就像金融市場的懸浮滑板，沒有太多實際用途，卻可能隨時起火爆炸。
Armour指出，過去4年個股ETF的報酬率中位數為負38%；自成立以來，有19%的個股ETF虧損超過75%，僅18%的產品表現優於其追蹤的股票。
業者坦言只適合短線交易
基金公司本身也強調，這些產品並非長期投資工具。Direxion執行長Douglas Yones向《巴隆周刊》表示，這類ETF是為交易者設計，並提醒投資人注意槓桿相關風險。
GraniteShares執行長Will Rhind則表示，SpaceX的案例顯示，市場對指標性IPO相關交易工具的需求不僅立即浮現，而且多空雙方都相當旺盛。
Rhind指出，當一家公司以創紀錄的估值掛牌時，許多交易者都希望透過明確工具，表達對其估值是否過高的看法。他預期，Anthropic上市後也會出現同樣強勁的雙向交易需求。
然而，散戶未必會依照產品原先設定的方式操作。
盈透證券首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，他理解槓桿對積極型交易客戶具有吸引力，但仍不相信這些產品都被投資人嚴格按照原定用途使用。
熱門新股掛牌後ETF迅速跟進
Anthropic相關ETF計畫並不令人意外。今年槓桿ETF人氣大增，交易者紛紛湧入與SanDisk、美光等熱門股票，以及費城半導體(SOX) 掛鉤的基金。
資產管理業者也因此加快推出與新上市公司連結的產品。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 與SK海力士(SKHY-US) 股票在美國掛牌交易後，僅過數天便有多檔相關ETF上市。
不過，想投資Anthropic仍有其他投機程度較低的方式。最直接的選擇，是等待IPO啟動後，設法在掛牌前取得股票配售。券商可能比照SpaceX上市時的做法，保留部分股份供散戶申購；投資人也可以等股票正式掛牌後，直接在次級市場買進。
部分ETF已提前持有Anthropic
對於不願等待的投資人，目前已有部分ETF透過持有私人股權的特殊目的工具，提前取得Anthropic尚未上市股份的曝險。

根據晨星資料，Tema Photonics & Optical ETF、Tema Electrification ETF、Alger Concentrated Equity ETF、Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF、Alger 35 ETF、iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF、T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF及T. Rowe Price Technology ETF，均持有Anthropic上市前股份。
IPO本身的風險已經不低，若再疊加槓桿，風險只會進一步放大。希望參與Anthropic成長的投資人，較穩健的做法可能是選擇持有該公司的多元化基金，或待Anthropic掛牌後直接買進普通股。
畢竟，就連Claude似乎也認為，Anthropic個股ETF並不是一個理想選擇。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic may still be weeks away from listing, but fund managers are already gearing up to launch single-stock ETFs that let investors amplify bets on the AI company's stock performance.

Anthropic, the developer of Claude, has quietly filed an IPO application and is expected to submit public documents in the coming weeks. This means Anthropic shares could debut as early as later this month or in October, at which point investors will have several single-stock ETFs to choose from to wager on the new AI stock.

However, strategists and even the AI itself warn that such products are highly volatile, requiring investors to have a very high risk tolerance and are unsuitable for a long‑term buy‑and‑hold approach.
Multiple fund managers line up leveraged products

Direxion, Tradr, Leverage Shares, GraniteShares and others have announced plans to roll out leveraged ETFs linked to Anthropic shortly after its stock begins trading. REX Shares and Tuttle Capital Management also applied in March to launch a pure long Anthropic ETF.
Leveraged single‑stock ETFs use options, swaps and futures to magnify the daily price movement of the underlying stock or index, with the most common offering 2× leverage.

For example, if a stock rises 2% in a day, a 2× long ETF would theoretically rise 4%; conversely, a 2× short or inverse ETF would fall 4%. If the stock falls 2%, a 2× inverse ETF would theoretically rise 4%.
These products sound extremely risky, and they indeed are. When asked whether single‑stock ETFs are safe overall, Anthropic’s Claude gave a very direct answer.
Claude said, "Short answer: not safe." It noted that all company‑specific risks—missed earnings, lawsuits, CEO controversies—are amplified by leverage.
Claude also pointed out that daily leverage creates a compounding effect, making these products generally designed for short‑term trading rather than long‑term holding.
Daily reset can cause returns to diverge from expectations

That reminder hits the nail on the head. Fund firms launching the products caution that leveraged ETFs reset daily, making them vulnerable to short‑term volatility. In other words, when the underlying stock keeps climbing, the long ETF’s cumulative gain may fall short of expectations; if the stock keeps falling, the inverse ETF’s loss can far exceed what investors anticipate.

Take GraniteShares’ 2× long Nvidia (NVDA‑US) daily ETF as an example: it’s up about 28.6% this year, well below twice Nvidia’s roughly 23.5% gain through 2026. By contrast, GraniteShares’ 2× short Nvidia daily ETF has plunged nearly 50% this year.
Claude isn’t the only one issuing warnings. Market experts also agree that single‑stock ETFs are not products the average investor can easily bear.

Morningstar North America’s ETF and passive‑strategy head Bryan Armour recently described single‑stock ETFs as “floating skateboards in the financial market—little practical use but capable of catching fire at any moment.”

Armour noted that over the past four years the median return of single‑stock ETFs has been –38%; since inception, 19% of them have lost more than 75%, and only 18% have outperformed the stocks they track.
Managers admit they’re only suitable for short‑term trading

Fund firms themselves stress that these products are not long‑term investment tools. Direxion CEO Douglas Yones told Barron’s that such ETFs are built for traders and warned investors about leverage‑related risks.
GraniteShares CEO Will Rhind said the SpaceX case shows demand for IPO‑linked trading tools spikes immediately, with strong interest on both the long and short sides.

Rhind added that when a company lists at a record valuation, many traders want a clear instrument to express whether they think the price is too high. He expects the same robust two‑way demand after Anthropic lists.
However, retail investors may not use the products as originally intended.
Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said he sees leverage appealing to aggressive traders but doubts that investors consistently use these products for their intended purpose.
Hot new‑issue ETFs follow listings quickly

Anthropic‑related ETF plans are unsurprising. Leveraged ETFs have surged in popularity this year, with traders flocking to products tied to hot stocks like SanDisk, Micron and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX).

Asset managers are accelerating the launch of products linked to newly listed companies. After SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) began trading in the U.S., several related ETFs were launched within days.

Nevertheless, there are lower‑speculation ways to invest in Anthropic. The simplest is to wait for the IPO and try to obtain an allocation before the shares hit the market. Brokers may, as with SpaceX, reserve a portion of shares for retail allocation; investors can also buy the stock on the secondary market once it lists.
Some ETFs already hold Anthropic ahead of the IPO
For investors unwilling to wait, certain ETFs have used special purpose vehicles that hold private‑equity stakes to gain exposure to Anthropic before its public debut.

According to Morningstar, the Tema Photonics & Optical ETF, Tema Electrification ETF, Alger Concentrated Equity ETF, Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF, Alger 35 ETF, iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF, T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF and T. Rowe Price Technology ETF all own pre‑IPO Anthropic shares.

The IPO itself carries significant risk, and adding leverage only magnifies it. Investors seeking Anthropic’s growth might be better off holding diversified funds that include the company or buying its ordinary shares after the listing.
After all, even Claude seems to think that an Anthropic single‑stock ETF is not an ideal choice.

items.title: 輝達砸130億美元收購Hugging Face 分析師：如同買「健康保險」
items.title_en: Nvidia Spends $13 B to Acquire Hugging Face, Analyst Says It's Like Buying "Health Insurance"
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 向來擅長透過投資維持晶片霸主地位，一名分析師認為，收購 Hugging Face 正是最新案例。
獨立研究機構 Radio Free Mobile 創辦人溫莎（Richard Windsor）表示，面對客製化晶片競爭日益加劇，輝達斥資 130 億美元收購這座開源人工智慧（AI）平台，可視為替自身購買一份「健康保險」。
溫莎認為，這筆交易的目的，在於確保沒有任何業者能夠壟斷 AI 模型及其衍生服務。他在周五發布的客戶報告中指出，對輝達而言，此舉將大幅有助於維持其在晶片市場的競爭優勢。
輝達企業 AI 副總裁博伊塔諾（Justin Boitano）上周四在交易公布後的電話會議上表示，公司有充分誘因與動力，讓 Hugging Face 維持開放與中立，使平台上超過 1,800 萬名 AI 開發者都能在任何平台執行模型並存取資料集。
溫莎表示，讓 Hugging Face 保持獨立，最符合輝達自身利益，因為這有助於避免市場占有率流向自行研發晶片的 AI 服務供應商。
溫莎指出，輝達能夠維持 AI 晶片市場領先地位，關鍵在於統一運算架構 CUDA。這套平台讓開發者能利用輝達繪圖處理器（GPU）執行通用運算任務。此外，輝達每年推出新產品的節奏，也使其至少領先競爭對手一個晶片世代。
然而，隨著 AI 產業重心轉向推論，也就是 AI 模型根據所學內容進行預測的過程，溫莎認為，輝達透過 CUDA 掌握的優勢正在減弱。CUDA 在模型訓練時代曾是輝達的重要護城河，但在涵蓋硬體到服務的完整 AI 技術堆疊中，其影響力主要仍局限於晶片層。
溫莎表示，如果 Hugging Face 能持續成為開源 AI 模型的首選平台，「就不會有任何一家業者能夠壟斷 AI 服務市場」，而這正是輝達影響力相對有限的領域。
他也點出 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 與 Anthropic 等公司的潛在威脅。這些業者正自行開發客製化晶片，用於支援自家 AI 產品與服務。溫莎表示，如果其中一家公司成為「AI 服務的主導推動者」，整個 AI 生態系便可能輕易轉向針對其自研晶片進行最佳化。
他警告，這不僅會削弱輝達的定價能力，還可能導致其流失「大量」市場占有率。
因此，只要開源 AI 模型能繼續作為前沿 AI 實驗室與大型雲端服務商封閉模型的「可行且蓬勃發展的替代方案」，輝達就有望抵禦來自 AI 技術堆疊其他環節的競爭，尤其是自身相對不具優勢的領域。
溫莎補充，在獲得輝達大筆投資後，Hugging Face 如今可以更專注投入資源，並擴大其作為主要開源平台的角色。
William Blair 分析師納吉（Sebastien Naji）對輝達收購 Hugging Face 的策略也持相近看法。他在客戶報告中表示：「藉由將觸角延伸至模型層，輝達進一步拓寬了 CUDA 的應用入口。」
納吉指出，輝達也能因此更清楚掌握開源開發的發展方向，有助於公司規畫產品藍圖，繼續維持其作為 AI 基礎設施標準的地位。
他表示：「掌握模型開發趨勢，可作為因應 ASIC 市占率上升的避險手段。隨著 AI 實驗室愈來愈多採用客製化晶片執行封閉式前沿模型，這項能力也更加重要。」ASIC 指的是特殊應用積體電路，例如 OpenAI 與博通共同開發的 Jalapeño。
納吉認為，輝達支持開源生態系，有助於確保 AI 硬體需求來源更加廣泛，並讓更多價值流向商用 GPU 生態系。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) has long been adept at using investments to maintain its chip dominance, and an analyst says the acquisition of Hugging Face is the latest example.

Richard Windsor, founder of the independent research firm Radio Free Mobile, said that faced with intensifying competition in custom chips, Nvidia’s $13 billion purchase of the open‑source AI platform can be seen as buying a form of "health insurance" for itself.

Windsor believes the purpose of the deal is to ensure no single player can monopolize AI models and their downstream services, noting in a client report released on Friday that the move will greatly help Nvidia preserve its competitive edge in the chip market.

Justin Boitano, Nvidia’s corporate AI vice‑president, said in a conference call after the announcement last Thursday that the company has strong incentives and motivation to keep Hugging Face open and neutral, allowing the platform’s more than 18 million AI developers to run models and access datasets on any platform.
Windsor said keeping Hugging Face independent is in Nvidia’s best interest because it helps prevent market share from flowing to AI service providers that develop their own chips.

Windsor pointed out that Nvidia’s ability to stay ahead in the AI chip market hinges on its unified computing architecture, CUDA, which lets developers use Nvidia GPUs for general‑purpose compute, and that Nvidia’s cadence of new product launches keeps it at least one chip generation ahead of rivals.

However, as the AI industry shifts toward inference—the phase where models make predictions based on what they have learned—Windsor believes Nvidia’s advantage through CUDA is waning. CUDA was a strong moat during the training era, but in a full AI stack that spans hardware to services its impact now largely remains at the chip layer.

Windsor said that if Hugging Face continues to be the preferred open‑source AI model platform, “no single player will be able to dominate the AI services market,” which is a domain where Nvidia’s influence is relatively limited.

He also highlighted potential threats from Alphabet’s Google and companies like Anthropic, which are developing custom chips to support their own AI products and services. Windsor warned that if any of them becomes the “dominant driver of AI services,” the entire AI ecosystem could easily shift to optimize for those proprietary chips.
He cautioned that this would not only erode Nvidia’s pricing power but could also cause it to lose a “large” share of the market.

Therefore, as long as open‑source AI models remain a viable and thriving alternative to the closed models of leading cloud providers and frontier AI labs, Nvidia can fend off competition from other layers of the AI stack, especially those where it lacks a clear advantage.
Windsor added that with Nvidia’s sizable investment, Hugging Face can now focus more resources on expanding its role as the primary open‑source platform.

Sebastien Naji, an analyst at William Blair, shares a similar view on Nvidia’s strategy. In his client note he wrote: “By extending its reach to the model layer, Nvidia further broadens the entry points for CUDA applications.”

Naji noted that this also gives Nvidia clearer insight into the direction of open‑source development, helping the company plan its product roadmap and maintain its status as the standard AI infrastructure provider.

He said, “Understanding model‑development trends can serve as a hedge against rising ASIC market share. As more AI labs adopt custom chips to run closed‑source frontier models, this capability becomes increasingly important.” ASIC refers to application‑specific integrated circuits, such as the Jalapeño chip co‑developed by OpenAI and Broadcom.
Naji believes Nvidia’s support of the open‑source ecosystem helps ensure a broader base of AI hardware demand and directs more value toward the commercial GPU ecosystem.

items.title: 美光股價重返1000美元大關能續攻嗎？《巴隆》解析：9月底財報成關鍵
items.title_en: Micron Stock Returns to $1,000 Level—Can It Keep Advancing? Barron’s Analysis: Q3 Earnings Critical
paras: 美光科技(MU-US) 股價在人工智慧（AI）題材重新升溫帶動下強勢走高，週五（5日）收盤首度站上每股1000美元，創8月中旬以來新高，市場持續關注AI基礎建設相關股票的資金動能。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，道瓊市場數據顯示，美光股價週五收盤上漲6.1%，收在1016.59美元，為8月17日以來首度收盤站上1000美元大關；該股本週累計上漲9%。
值得注意的是，美光股價逆勢走強之際，美股大盤表現相對疲弱。受到優於預期的就業數據影響，標普500指數週五下跌0.4%，道瓊工業指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數也下跌0.3%。
市場對AI基礎建設相關股票重新燃起投資熱情，被視為推升美光股價的重要因素之一。OpenAI最新推出的GPT-6 Astra AI模型近期表現受到關注，早期基準測試結果亮眼，可能有助於緩解市場對OpenAI高達1.4兆美元支出承諾的疑慮。
其他記憶體公司方面，SK海力士(000660KS) 的美國存託憑證(SKHY-US) 上漲8.1%。SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 則大漲11.9%，成為當天標普500指數中表現最佳的股票。
不過，單日強漲仍不足以確認美光股價已重新確立上升趨勢。美光股價自6月觸及高點後，累計回落約20%，且自8月中旬以來持續在50日移動平均線附近震盪，目前該均線約位於935美元。
現階段市場仍難判斷50日線究竟已轉為股價支撐，或反而形成壓力。
後續值得關注的關鍵催化劑，將是美光即將公布的財報。公司預計在9月30日公布2026會計年度第4季財報，屆時業績與展望能否進一步推動股價突破，將成為市場觀察焦點。
值得一提的是，《巴隆》先前曾在美光股價站上1100美元附近時提出看法，認為美光股價仍存在翻倍的可能性。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US) saw its share price surge strongly as AI themes regained momentum, closing on Friday (the 5th) above $1,000 for the first time and hitting a new high since mid‑August, with the market still watching capital flows into AI infrastructure stocks.

According to Barron’s Weekly, Dow Jones market data showed Micron’s shares closed up 6.1% on Friday at $1,016.59, marking the first closing above $1,000 since August 17, and the stock is up about 9% for the week.

It is noteworthy that Micron’s price rose against a relatively weak broader market. Following better‑than‑expected employment data, the S&P 500 fell 0.4% on Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.5%, and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.3%.

Renewed investor enthusiasm for AI‑infrastructure stocks is seen as a key driver behind Micron’s rally. OpenAI’s newly launched GPT‑6 Astra model has drawn attention for strong early benchmark results, which could help allay market concerns over OpenAI’s $1.4 trillion spending commitment.
Among other memory makers, SK Hynix’s (000660KS) American Depositary Receipt (SKHY‑US) rose 8.1%, while SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) jumped 11.9%, making it the best‑performing stock in the S&P 500 that day.

However, a single‑day surge is not enough to confirm that Micron’s price has re‑established an uptrend. Since peaking in June, Micron has fallen roughly 20% and has been trading near its 50‑day moving average since mid‑August, which currently sits around $935.
At this stage it remains unclear whether the 50‑day line has become a support level for the stock or is turning into resistance.

The next key catalyst to watch will be Micron’s upcoming earnings report. The company plans to release its FY 2026 Q4 results on September 30, and whether the performance and outlook can further push the price higher will be a focal point for the market.
It is worth noting that Barron’s previously commented when Micron’s price approached $1,100, suggesting the stock still had the potential to double.

items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉秦永沛：台積電卓越製造沒有捷徑 近40年靠團隊一步一腳印
items.title_en: TSMC Executive Qin Yong‑pei Named 15th Academician of ITRI: No Shortcut to TSMC’s Manufacturing Excellence, Built Step by Step Over 40 Years
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)執行副總經理暨共同營運長秦永沛今(7)日獲選第15屆工研院院士。他在致詞時表示，工研院長年扮演台灣科技產業「開路先鋒」與人才培育的重要角色，當年正是透過工研院的人才培育與技術轉移，為台積電成立奠定關鍵基礎，也點燃台灣半導體產業走向世界的曙光。
秦永沛表示，今日能獲選工研院院士，對他而言是一份無上的肯定與榮譽。他回顧台灣半導體產業發展指出，台灣今日能在全球半導體產業占有關鍵地位，可說是一部「台灣奇蹟」，而工研院在最關鍵的時刻，為產業茁壯灌溉養分。
他指出，當年工研院透過人才培育與技術轉移，在台積電成立初期提供重要人才基礎，不僅造就今日台積電的成功，也進一步帶動整體台灣半導體產業走向全球。這份連結不只是技術傳承，更是台灣半導體產業走向世界的重要起點。
秦永沛1982年自成功大學電機研究所畢業後，即加入工研院電子所，先後投入品質保證(QA)及研發工作。他表示，電子所提供非常好的學習環境，在前後四年半的時間裡，為他打下半導體職涯的重要基礎。
1987年，秦永沛離開工研院電子所，加入剛成立不久的台積電，成為早期員工之一。回顧近40年的台積電生涯，他強調，半導體的卓越製造與技術研發「沒有捷徑」，台積電能有今日成就，是在歷任董事長包括張忠謀、劉德音，現任董事長魏哲家具有遠見的領導下，以及所有同仁一步一腳印累積而來。
秦永沛表示，在台積電職涯中，長年與營運團隊共同努力，克服無數技術瓶頸，將卓越製造技術進一步轉化為量產實力，並透過大規模穩定製造支撐全球科技創新，這些成就絕對不是任何一個人能夠單獨完成，而是整個團隊長期共同努力的成果。
致詞中，秦永沛特別向台積電創辦人張忠謀致上敬意與感謝。他表示，張忠謀當年以遠見與胸襟創立晶圓代工商業模式，不僅改變全球半導體產業，也在他的職涯中給予最關鍵的啟發與信任。他同時感謝台積電董事長魏哲家、前董事長劉德音及歷年長官的領導與提攜，使營運團隊能持續在全球卓越製造的競爭賽道上全力衝刺。
秦永沛也特別感謝所有曾共同工作的台積電同仁。他表示，正是因為團隊攜手同行，才能一次又一次克服困難，將挑戰轉化為成功，同時持續創造新的製造與技術突破。
展望未來，秦永沛表示，仍將持續為台積電與台灣科技產業貢獻心力，並攜手供應鏈與產業生態系夥伴，共同推動卓越製造與永續發展。
他最後再次感謝工研院，不僅引領他踏入半導體產業，也給予他院士這份最高肯定。不過，秦永沛強調，這份榮譽不應只屬於個人，而應歸屬於台積電整個營運團隊，以及近40年來每一位堅守崗位的台積人。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Qin Yong‑pei was selected today (the 7th) as a 15th‑session Academician of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). In his remarks he said ITRI has long played a pioneering role and a key talent‑development function for Taiwan’s tech industry; it was through ITRI’s talent cultivation and technology transfer that the foundation for TSMC’s founding was laid, igniting the dawn of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry on the world stage.

Qin said being chosen as an ITRI Academician is the highest affirmation and honor for him. He reflected on the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, noting that Taiwan’s current pivotal position in the global semiconductor arena is a “Taiwan miracle,” and that ITRI supplied essential nourishment to the industry at its most critical moments.

He pointed out that, back then, ITRI’s talent training and technology transfer provided a vital talent base during TSMC’s early days, not only creating today’s TSMC success but also propelling the entire Taiwanese semiconductor industry worldwide. This link is more than a technical hand‑over; it is the crucial starting point for Taiwan’s semiconductor industry to go global.

Qin graduated in 1982 from the Electrical Engineering Graduate Institute of National Cheng Kung University and immediately joined ITRI’s Electronics Institute, working in quality assurance (QA) and R&D. He said the Electronics Institute offered an excellent learning environment and, over four and a half years, laid the foundation for his semiconductor career.

In 1987 Qin left ITRI’s Electronics Institute to join the newly founded TSMC, becoming one of its early employees. Looking back on nearly 40 years at TSMC, he emphasized that there is “no shortcut” to excellence in semiconductor manufacturing and R&D; TSMC’s achievements stem from the visionary leadership of successive chairmen—including Morris Chang, Dr. Liu De‑yin, and current chairman Dr. Wei Zhe‑jia—and the steady, step‑by‑step contributions of all colleagues.

Qin noted that throughout his TSMC career he has worked closely with the operations team to overcome countless technical bottlenecks, turning manufacturing excellence into mass‑production capability and supporting global tech innovation with large‑scale, stable production. These accomplishments are the result of long‑term collective effort, not any single individual’s work.

In his speech Qin paid special tribute to TSMC founder Morris Chang, thanking him for establishing the foundry business model with vision and generosity, which reshaped the global semiconductor industry and gave Qin the most critical inspiration and trust in his career. He also thanked Chairman Wei Zhe‑jia, former chairman Liu De‑yin, and past leaders for their guidance that enabled the operations team to sprint full‑throttle on the global excellence‑manufacturing race track.

Qin also expressed gratitude to all TSMC colleagues he has worked with, saying that it is the teamwork that has repeatedly overcome difficulties, turning challenges into successes while continuously creating new manufacturing and technology breakthroughs.

Looking ahead, Qin said he will continue to devote his energy to TSMC and Taiwan’s technology industry, collaborating with the supply chain and ecosystem partners to jointly advance manufacturing excellence and sustainable development.

He concluded by thanking ITRI again for leading him into the semiconductor field and granting him the highest honor of Academician. However, Qin stressed that this honor belongs not to an individual but to the entire TSMC operations team and every TSMC employee who has steadfastly served over the past four decades.

items.title: 高盛：AI記憶體週期被低估！南韓KOSPI目標12000點、仍有約80%的上漲空間
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: AI Memory Cycle Underestimated! South Korea KOSPI Target 12,000 Points, Still About 80% Upside
paras: 高盛集團一名策略師仍維持對南韓股市的樂觀目標，並表示投資人低估了人工智慧（AI）熱潮對南韓記憶體晶片製造商帶來的提振效應將持續多久。
根據《彭博》報導，該投資銀行亞太區股票策略主管Timothy Moe維持韓國綜合股價指數（KOSPI）12,000點的目標價，代表較目前水準仍有近80%的上漲空間。
他在3個月前提出這項預估時，該目標價已是華爾街最為樂觀的預測之一。
Moe近日接受採訪時表示，高盛仍維持原先目標，主要依據是企業獲利實際表現。他認為，市場低估了這一輪獲利週期的持續時間。
KOSPI近期表現則與高盛的樂觀看法形成反差。該指數自6月創下的歷史高點回落27%，市場擔憂科技巨頭AI支出的成長能否持續，加上南韓股市波動加劇，即使三星電子(005930KS) 與SK海力士(000660KS) 再度交出亮眼財報，也未能明顯提振股價。
不過，全球爭相興建資料中心，已導致記憶體與儲存晶片出現嚴重短缺，進而推升相關產品價格。Moe預期，這項趨勢到了2027年還將進一步加劇。
他表示，美國大型科技公司明年的支出預估將超過1.2兆美元，遠高於先前預估的8,000億美元。
Moe認為：「即使賺不到錢，也必須持續支出」。他指出：「這對記憶體而言非常有利，因為這將推動運算需求，而運算高度依賴記憶體。」
高盛估計，KOSPI成分股今年獲利將成長約360%，2027年則放緩至約35%。他補充，企業獲利最終將開始放緩，這一點市場其實已經相當清楚。
Moe同時承認，南韓記憶體產業仍面臨中國競爭對手長鑫科技(688825-CN) 等企業帶來的風險，以及美國資料中心擴建可能遭遇政治阻力。
不過，他認為未來幾年基本面仍有利於先進記憶體晶片業者。
在估值方面，Moe的12,000點KOSPI目標，是以未來本益比7.5倍為基礎；目前KOSPI僅約5.3倍，約為過去7年平均值的一半。
Moe表示，如果南韓企業最終能達到高盛預期的獲利水準，那麼12,000點的KOSPI目標，「可能沒有看起來那麼瘋狂」。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Goldman Sachs strategist continues to hold an optimistic outlook for the South Korean stock market, saying investors underestimate how long the AI boom will boost South Korean memory chip makers.

According to Bloomberg, the investment bank’s Asia‑Pacific equity strategy head Timothy Moe maintains a 12,000‑point target for the Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI), implying roughly 80% upside from current levels.
When he made the forecast three months ago, that target was among the most bullish on Wall Street.

Moe said in a recent interview that Goldman Sachs still sticks to the original target, basing it mainly on companies’ actual earnings performance, and believes the market is underestimating the duration of this profit cycle.

KOSPI’s recent performance runs counter to Goldman’s optimism, having fallen 27% from its June all‑time high as investors worry whether AI spending by tech giants can be sustained, and heightened volatility in the Korean market has left even strong earnings from Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS) unable to lift the index.
However, a global rush to build data centers has created a severe shortage of memory and storage chips, pushing up prices, and Moe expects the trend to intensify further by 2027.
He noted that U.S. big‑tech firms are projected to spend more than $1.2 trillion next year, far above the previous $800 billion estimate.
Moe said, “Even if you’re not making money, you have to keep spending.” He added, “That’s very favorable for memory because it drives compute demand, and compute heavily relies on memory.”

Goldman estimates that KOSPI constituents’ earnings will grow about 360% this year, slowing to roughly 35% by 2027, and he added that the market already understands that corporate profits will eventually decelerate.
Moe also acknowledged that South Korea’s memory industry faces risks from Chinese rivals such as ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) and possible political resistance to U.S. data‑center expansion.
Nevertheless, he believes fundamentals will remain supportive of advanced memory chip makers over the next few years.
In valuation terms, Moe’s 12,000‑point KOSPI target is based on a forward price‑to‑earnings multiple of 7.5×; the index currently trades at about 5.3×, roughly half its seven‑year average.
Moe said that if South Korean companies ultimately achieve the profit levels Goldman expects, the 12,000‑point KOSPI target “might not look that crazy.”
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 黃仁勳宣告「AGI已經到來」！OpenAI GPT-6 Astra訓練動用逾10萬套輝達系統
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Declares “AGI Has Arrived”! OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra Trained Using Over 100,000 NVIDIA Systems
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳表示，通用人工智慧（AGI）時代已經到來，並將OpenAI最新模型GPT-6 Astra的推出，視為人工智慧（AI）系統快速發展的重要里程碑。
根據《Investing.com》報導，黃仁勳週日（6日）在社群平台X發文祝賀OpenAI推出Astra，並直言：「AGI已經到來。」
OpenAI則將Astra形容為目前最具智慧且最「對齊」的AI系統，在電腦操作、軟體工程、網路安全、科學研究及專業工作等領域均展現領先表現。
黃仁勳指出，Astra的訓練使用超過10萬套輝達Grace Blackwell NVLink72系統，凸顯開發尖端AI模型所需的龐大運算資源。
他表示，從ChatGPT到o1，再到Astra，OpenAI僅花了4年時間，並透露接下來將有40萬顆GPU陸續投入運作。
OpenAI總裁布洛克曼（Greg Brockman）同樣曾表示，Astra可能象徵AGI時代的開端。不過，AGI目前並沒有全球一致認可的明確定義。
在性能測試方面，OpenAI表示，Astra在FrontierMath Tier 4取得98%分數，在ARC-AGI-3達到99.9%，並在ExploitBench測試中取得100%的成績。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang said the era of artificial general intelligence (AGI) has arrived and called the launch of OpenAI’s latest model, GPT‑6 Astra, a major milestone in the rapid development of AI systems.
According to Investing.com, Huang posted on X on Sunday the 6th to congratulate OpenAI on releasing Astra and stated plainly, “AGI has arrived.”

OpenAI describes Astra as the most intelligent and most “aligned” AI system to date, showing leading performance across computer operation, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific research, and professional work.
Huang noted that Astra’s training employed more than 100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink‑72 systems, underscoring the massive compute resources required to develop cutting‑edge AI models.
He said that moving from ChatGPT to o1 and now to Astra took OpenAI only four years, and revealed that 400,000 GPUs will be rolled out gradually in the near future.
OpenAI President Greg Brockman also said Astra could mark the beginning of the AGI era, though there is still no globally accepted, precise definition of AGI at present.
In performance testing, OpenAI reported that Astra scored 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, achieved 99.9% on ARC‑AGI‑3, and attained a perfect 100% on the ExploitBench benchmark.

items.title: 蘋果、華為、小米拚場 折疊機本周集中亮相
items.title_en: Apple, Huawei, Xiaomi Battle It Out as Foldable Phones Debut This Week
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 、華為、小米(01810-HK) 拚場，本月7日下午至10日凌晨，華為、小米、蘋果將接連發布各自折疊旗艦手機。
華為定9月7日14時30分召開HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2及全場景新品發表會，主角為第二代三折疊Mate XT 2非凡大師。
同日晚間7時，小米將舉辦秋季旗艦發表會，推出旗下首款「闊折疊」旗艦小米18 Fold。
蘋果將在當地時間9月9日（台灣時間9月10日凌晨1時）舉行秋季新品發表會，這也是特納斯（John Ternus）接任執行長後首場產品發表會。
最大懸念自然是蘋果傳聞已久的首款折疊iPhone，同時iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max等高階機型也會同步亮相。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US), Huawei and Xiaomi (01810-HK) are gearing up for a showdown, with Huawei, Xiaomi and Apple set to unveil their respective flagship foldable phones between the afternoon of the 7th and the early hours of the 10th of this month.

Huawei will hold a HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 and all‑scenario new‑product launch at 14:30 on September 7, featuring the second‑generation three‑fold Mate XT 2 “Extraordinary Master” as the star of the show.
That same evening at 19:00, Xiaomi will host its autumn flagship launch, introducing its first “wide‑fold” flagship, the Xiaomi 18 Fold.
Apple will hold its autumn product launch at 01:00 Taiwan time on September 10 (local time September 9), marking the first product event since John Ternus took over as CEO.
The biggest question mark is the long‑rumored first foldable iPhone, which is expected to be unveiled alongside high‑end models such as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

items.title: 澤倫斯基與川普特使結束第一階段會談！威特科夫：目前進展「令人鼓舞」
items.title_en: Zelensky and Trump Envoy Conclude First Stage Talks! Witkoff: Progress Is "Encouraging"
paras: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）率領的談判團隊，週日（6日）在基輔與美國總統特使威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）及美國總統川普女婿庫許納（Jared Kushner）率領的代表團舉行會談，雙方當天已結束首階段磋商。威特科夫會後表示，此次會談「令人鼓舞」。
根據烏克蘭國家通訊社報導，雙方在當地時間下午5時左右結束歷時約3小時的第一階段會談。威特科夫在會後表示，這次會談「務實且重要」，美方對目前進展「感到非常鼓舞」，並期待後續能取得更多進展。
烏克蘭國家通訊社公布的照片顯示，烏方談判團隊成員包括澤倫斯基、人民公僕黨黨主席阿拉哈米亞（David Arakhamia）、總統辦公室主任布達諾夫（Kyrylo Budanov）、對外情報局局長烏梅羅夫（Rustem Umerov），以及總統辦公室第一副主任基斯利察（Andrii Sybiha）。
報導指出，雙方第二階段談判預計於週一（7日）晚些時候舉行，屆時將邀請英國、德國及法國的國家安全事務顧問參與。
澤倫斯基6日中午則透過社群媒體表示，在美國總統特使抵達基輔前，他已先召集烏克蘭談判團隊開會。他強調，烏方將維持一貫的建設性態度，致力推動俄烏戰事儘快結束。
澤倫斯基表示，烏克蘭需要和平與安全保障，也需要一份「體面的戰後和平」，目前已準備好相關提議。他強調，接下來的工作重點在於以「協調、務實且富有成效」的方式推進談判。
paras_en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy led a negotiation team that met on Sunday (the 6th) in Kyiv with a delegation headed by U.S. presidential envoy Steve Witkoff and former President Trump’s son‑in‑law Jared Kushner. The two sides wrapped up the first‑stage consultations that day, and Witkoff said after the meeting that it was "encouraging."

According to the Ukrainian national news agency, the parties concluded the roughly three‑hour first‑stage talks around 5 p.m. local time. Witkoff said the meeting was "practical and important," that the U.S. side felt "very encouraged" by the current progress, and that they look forward to achieving further advances in subsequent talks.

Photos released by the Ukrainian national news agency show the Ukrainian negotiating team included Zelenskyy, David Arakhamia – chairman of the Servant of the People party, Kyrylo Budanov – head of the President’s Office, Rustem Umerov – head of the Foreign Intelligence Service, and Andrii Sybiha – first deputy head of the President’s Office.
The report notes that the second‑stage negotiations are slated for later on Monday (the 7th), with national security advisers from the United Kingdom, Germany and France expected to take part.

Zelenskyy posted on social media at noon on the 6th that, before the U.S. presidential envoy arrived in Kyiv, he had already convened the Ukrainian negotiating team. He stressed that Ukraine will maintain its consistently constructive stance and work to bring the Russia‑Ukraine war to an end as quickly as possible.

Zelenskyy said Ukraine needs peace and security guarantees, as well as a "decent post‑war peace," and that it is ready with related proposals. He emphasized that the next focus is to advance the talks in a "coordinated, pragmatic and productive" manner.

items.title: 利潤增速遠超營收！A股封測三強半年報出爐：AI點燃先進封裝長期成長引擎
items.title_en: Profit Growth Far Outpaces Revenue! A-Share Packaged-Testing Leaders Release Mid-Year Reports: AI Ignites Long-Term Growth Engine for Advanced Packaging
paras: 在摩爾定律趨近物理極限、加上中國國內先進晶圓製程外部受限的背景下，封裝已從傳統後道「保護＋引腳引出」的配套工序，升級為「靠異質集成、芯粒(Chiplet)拼接延續晶片性能爬坡」的核心路徑。
《中國經營報》報導，中國國內兩大半導體封測廠長電科技、通富微電，以及中國大陸唯一實現2.5D異質集成大規模量產的盛合晶微，日前相繼發布今年上半年業績，整體受惠AI算力與記憶體市場景氣上行，業績增長，卻呈現不同的結構性特徵。
財報顯示，長電科技上半年營收195.27億元(人民幣，下同)，年增4.96%；歸母淨利潤8.45億元，年增79.41%；扣非淨利潤8.08億元，年增84.73%。其中第二季淨利約5.54億元，季增約90%。
值得注意的是，5%左右的收入增長並非焦點，而是利潤增速遠甩營收，反映業務結構變化，收入結構正進一步向汽車電子、高性能計算等方向傾斜。
今年上半年，長電科技收入按應用領域劃分：通訊電子占27.4%、消費電子23.2%、運算電子30.1%、汽車電子11.1%、工業及醫療電子8.2%。其中運算電子營收年增40.4%，汽車電子年增25.0%。
值得注意的是，長電今年7月揭露的調研紀要提到，該公司去年即先於行業推動業務結構調整，並對傳統通訊業務有所取捨，通訊及消費電子收入占比已較歷史週期顯著收斂，內部結構主要面向需求韌性較強的高端市場。
長電在半年報指出，受惠AI相關基礎設施及端側領域需求快速增長、國產半導體替代趨勢明顯，以及客戶訂單持續增長、產能利用率高位運行等因素。
另一封測大廠通富微電今年上半年營收達160.41億元，年增23.03%；歸母淨利潤17.17億元，年增316.77%；扣非淨利潤7.47億元，年增77.78%。今年第二季營收約85.59億元、歸母淨利約13.88億元、扣非歸母淨利約5.76億元，三項指標均創公司單季歷史新高。
通富微電表示，該公司緊扣「AI＋記憶體＋車載＋國產客戶」四條增長曲線，精準承接算力、記憶體等高成長領域，市場開拓與產能利用同步走強，交出「營收提速、中高端產品占比提升、利潤大幅躍升」的半年答卷。
通富微電還指出，大客戶超微半導體(AMD)今年上半年營收和盈利均創歷史新高，其中資料中心業務營收年增一倍以上。據了解，通富與AMD維持「合資＋合作」模式，是超微最主要的封測供應商，占其相關產品八成以上。
相較兩大傳統龍頭，主攻先進封裝的盛合晶微今年上半年營收34.07億元，年增7.20%；歸母淨利4.49億元，年增3.33%；扣非淨利4.36億元，年增3.31%。公司解釋，營收與淨利增長係「銷量增加、銷售規模增長所致」。
今年上半年，盛合晶微的中段矽片加工、晶圓級封裝、芯粒多晶片集成封裝等三大業務營收分別年增13.55%、10.60%、2.61%，其中芯粒多晶片集成封裝業務營收占比達53.66%。
根據世界半導體貿易統計組織(WSTS)統計，今年上半年以AI伺服器與記憶體晶片為代表的算力相關需求，已成為不可逆的增長引擎。

本輪AI帶動的先進封裝高景氣，究竟是短期供需錯配，還是長期結構性增長的開端，對此TrendForce分析師喬安表示，因AI HPC對晶片算力需求爆發式增長，先進封裝將迎來長期結構性增長機遇，主要包含兩大動能：一是突破摩爾定律物理極限——傳統單晶片依靠電晶體微縮提升效能的方式已面臨物理極限與成本效益瓶頸，IC開始轉向Chiplet架構，將不同功能及不同製程的小晶片進行異質整合，而先進封裝正是實現高頻寬、低延遲異質整合的核心關鍵技術；二是突破記憶體牆限制——AI模型不論訓練或推論皆極度依賴HBM，而HBM必須透過先進封裝才能與GPU／xPU緊密串聯。只要AI對海量資料傳輸與算力的需求不減，先進封裝需求就會持續增長。
喬安還說，封裝技術已從過去低附加價值的「後段加工」，升格為決定晶片最終效能的前段延伸核心。「各大晶圓代工廠與封測廠都大幅增加先進封裝資本支出，顯現其作為未來數十年半導體產業主要成長引擎的長期趨勢。」
在此長期趨勢下，中國重量級封測廠正加大資本投入擴產；長電科技、通富微電、華天科技三大龍頭集體擴產，甬矽電子、盛合晶微、深科技等亦紛紛啟動擴產計畫。
paras_en: Amid Moore's Law approaching its physical limits and domestic advanced wafer processes in China facing external constraints, packaging has evolved from the traditional back‑end "protect + lead out" steps into a core pathway that relies on heterogeneous integration and chiplet stitching to continue the performance climb of chips.

China Business News reported that China’s two major semiconductor packaging and testing firms, Changdian Technology and Tongfu Microelectronics, along with the mainland’s only company to achieve large‑scale mass production of 2.5D heterogeneous integration, Shenghe Chip Micro, have recently released their first‑half‑year results. Benefiting overall from the up‑turn in AI compute power and memory markets, their earnings grew but displayed different structural characteristics.

The financial statements show Changdian Technology posted first‑half revenue of RMB 19.527 billion, up 4.96% year‑on‑year; net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 845 million, up 79.41%; and non‑recurring net profit of RMB 808 million, up 84.73%. The second‑quarter net profit was about RMB 554 million, roughly a 90% quarterly increase.

It is noteworthy that the roughly 5% revenue growth is not the focus; profit growth far outpaced revenue, reflecting a shift in business structure as the revenue mix tilts further toward automotive electronics, high‑performance computing and other high‑margin segments.

In the first half of the year, Changdian’s revenue by application segment was: communications electronics 27.4%, consumer electronics 23.2%, computing electronics 30.1%, automotive electronics 11.1% and industrial/medical electronics 8.2%. Computing electronics revenue rose 40.4% year‑on‑year, while automotive electronics grew 25.0%.

It is worth noting that a research briefing disclosed by Changdian in July indicated the company had already led the industry in adjusting its business structure last year, trimming traditional communications lines. The shares of communications and consumer electronics revenue have already converged significantly from historical cycles, with the internal structure now aimed at high‑end markets with stronger demand resilience.

Changdian’s half‑year report attributes its performance to rapid growth in AI‑related infrastructure and edge‑side demand, a clear trend toward domestic semiconductor substitution, continued customer order growth and high capacity utilization.

Another major tester, Tongfu Microelectronics, reported first‑half revenue of RMB 16.041 billion, up 23.03% year‑on‑year; net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.717 billion, up 316.77%; and non‑recurring net profit of RMB 747 million, up 77.78%. In the second quarter, revenue was about RMB 8.559 billion, net profit attributable to shareholders about RMB 1.388 billion and non‑recurring net profit about RMB 576 million, all three hitting the company’s single‑quarter historical highs.

Tongfu said it is tightly aligning with four growth curves—AI, memory, automotive and domestic customers—precisely capturing high‑growth areas such as compute and memory. Market expansion and capacity utilization are both strengthening, delivering a half‑year answer of "accelerated revenue, higher share of mid‑to‑high‑end products, and a sharp profit jump."

Tongfu also pointed out that its major customer AMD posted record‑high revenue and profit in the first half, with data‑center revenue more than doubling year‑on‑year. It is understood that Tongfu maintains a "joint‑venture + cooperation" model with AMD and is AMD’s primary packaging and testing supplier, covering over 80% of AMD’s related products.

Compared with the two traditional leaders, advanced‑packaging specialist Shenghe Chip Micro posted first‑half revenue of RMB 3.407 billion, up 7.20% year‑on‑year; net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 449 million, up 3.33%; and non‑recurring net profit of RMB 436 million, up 3.31%. The company explained that the revenue and profit growth stem from increased sales volume and scale.

In the first half, Shenghe’s three main businesses—mid‑stage silicon wafer processing, wafer‑level packaging and chiplet multi‑die integration packaging—recorded year‑on‑year revenue growth of 13.55%, 10.60% and 2.61% respectively, with chiplet multi‑die integration packaging accounting for 53.66% of its revenue.

According to the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS), demand for compute‑related chips such as AI servers and memory chips has become an irreversible growth engine in the first half of the year.

Regarding whether the current AI‑driven boom in advanced packaging is a short‑term supply‑demand mismatch or the start of long‑term structural growth, TrendForce analyst Qiao An said that the explosive AI HPC demand for chip compute power will give advanced packaging a long‑term structural growth opportunity, driven by two main forces: first, breaking Moore’s Law’s physical limits—traditional single‑chip scaling faces physical and cost barriers, prompting ICs to shift to chiplet architectures that heterogeneously integrate small chips of different functions and processes, with advanced packaging being the key technology for high‑bandwidth, low‑latency integration; second, overcoming the memory‑wall—AI models, whether training or inference, heavily rely on HBM, which requires advanced packaging to tightly link with GPUs/xPUs. As long as AI’s massive data‑transfer and compute needs persist, demand for advanced packaging will keep rising.

Qiao added that packaging technology has risen from a low‑value‑added "back‑end process" to a front‑end core that determines a chip’s ultimate performance. "All major wafer foundries and test‑packaging firms are dramatically increasing capital spending on advanced packaging, reflecting its long‑term trend as the primary growth engine of the semiconductor industry for decades to come."

Against this long‑term trend, heavyweight Chinese test‑packaging firms are ramping up capital investment and capacity expansion; Changdian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics and Huatian Technology are collectively expanding capacity, while Yongsil Electronics, Shenghe Chip Micro and DeepTech are also launching expansion projects.

items.title: 亞馬遜貨機降落時出事 衝出跑道 至少5人死亡
items.title_en: Amazon Cargo Plane Crashes on Landing, Veers Off Runway, At Least 5 Dead
paras: 美國邁阿密國際機場6日（周日）發生一起貨機事故，一架亞馬遜(AMZN-US) Prime Air貨機降落時衝出跑道，撞上地面多輛車輛，造成至少5人死亡、5人受傷，其中3人傷勢危重。
據《路透社》報導，這架Prime Air 7598航班當天14時左右降落邁阿密國際機場，衝出機場一條斜向跑道，撞上地面多輛車輛。事故發生後，機場關閉全部跑道和滑行道。
美國交通部長肖恩·達菲表示，機場關閉可能造成大量延誤和航班取消，提醒旅客做好出行受影響的準備。
美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）證實，涉事飛機為一架波音767-300型貨機，事發前從波多黎各聖胡安起飛。亞馬遜表示，這架飛機由貨運航空公司21 Air負責營運。
《路透社》發布的現場照片顯示，飛機機頭著地，機尾翹起，機身右側出現疑似燒焦痕跡。
亞馬遜發言人凱莉·南特爾表示，仍在了解事故具體情況，並與當地政府和相關部門合作調查。她說，目前最重要的是確保所有涉事人員安全。
目前事故原因尚未公布。美國聯邦航空管理局表示，將對這起事故展開調查。
邁阿密-戴德縣航空部門此前確認機場發生事故。當地消防救援部門表示，有多名傷者被送往救治。
paras_en: On Sunday, June 6, a cargo aircraft operated by Amazon (AMZN-US) Prime Air experienced an accident at Miami International Airport in the United States. The plane burst off the runway during landing and struck several vehicles on the ground, killing at least five people and injuring five others, three of whom are in critical condition.

According to Reuters, the Prime Air Flight 7598 landed at roughly 14:00 at Miami International Airport and then veered onto a diagonal taxiway, colliding with multiple ground vehicles. After the incident, the airport shut down all runways and taxiways.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy warned that the airport closure could cause widespread delays and flight cancellations, urging travelers to prepare for possible disruptions to their journeys.

The Federal Aviation Administration confirmed that the aircraft involved was a Boeing 767‑300 cargo plane that had taken off from San Juan, Puerto Rico. Amazon said the flight was operated by cargo carrier 21 Air.
Photos released by Reuters show the aircraft’s nose on the ground with the tail lifted, and apparent scorch marks on the right side of the fuselage.

Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nanter explained that the company is still gathering details about the crash and is cooperating with local authorities and relevant agencies in the investigation. She emphasized that the top priority is ensuring the safety of everyone involved.
The cause of the accident has not yet been released. The FAA said it will launch an investigation into the incident.
Miami‑Dade County’s aviation department had previously confirmed the accident at the airport. Local fire‑rescue services reported that multiple injured persons were transported for medical treatment.

items.title: AI模型加速迭代！科技巨頭上周密集更新　業界憂「模型疲勞」與失控風險
items.title_en: AI Model Iterations Accelerate! Tech Giants Roll Out Updates Last Week, Industry Warns of “Model Fatigue” and Runaway Risks
paras: AI產業上週再度迎來一輪密集更新：Anthropic先升級Fable與Mythos模型，Meta、谷歌相繼推出新版模型，OpenAI緊接著發布 GPT-6 Astra。短短一週多家競逐AI技術領先地位的公司接力出招，節奏之快令人目不暇給。
OpenAI執行長奧特曼上週四(3日)接受《CNBC》訪問時坦言：「我們都在加快迭代節奏。」他認為，近期更新速度加快的部分原因，在於「大家都結束暑假回來了」。
不過，對AI模型與服務的用戶而言，這種快速迭代也帶來複雜與混亂。為避免掉隊，企業執行長與IT主管不得不投入大量時間與資源，比較不同產品的價格與能力。
AI新創公司Runpod執行長 Zhen Lu直言：「我覺得『模型疲勞』確實已成為一個真實存在的問題。別誤會，我對目前發生的各種創新感到非常興奮，但我確實認為，我們現在所處的環境有太多泡沫，企業不得不不斷製造聲量。」
聖母大學門多薩商學院教授、擁有25年AI從業經驗的Ahmed Abbasi指出，各家模型開發商如今都在爭奪用戶預算份額，一方面努力跟上對手節奏，一方面不斷提醒開發者，自己至少與其他公司一樣快地推進創新。
由於Anthropic與OpenAI正朝IPO上市邁進，競爭節奏格外激烈。目前，私募投資人給這兩家公司的估值都已接近1兆美元。Google 與 Meta 亦各有戰略目標，而快速發展的開源 AI 社群最近又迎來重量級新成員—輝達。
上週更新潮由Anthropic在上週二(1日)率先揭開序幕。該公司發布Claude Fable 5.1與Claude Mythos 5.1，號稱是「全球最先進的程式設計與知識工作模型」。
隔天，Meta發布Muse Spark 1.3，谷歌推出Gemini 3.8 Flash，兩家公司都主打新模型在程式設計與AI Agent 任務上的能力提升。
到了上週四，OpenAI發布GPT-6 Astra，重點強化網路安全與電腦操作能力，並稱其為「多年研究和重大投入」的成果。同日，位於阿布達比的穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智慧大學也向開源社群發布K2 Horizon系列模型，再次凸顯AI研究與投資已是一場全球競賽。
與此同時，全球市值最高的公司、本波AI 熱潮核心晶片供應商輝達也不甘示弱，宣布以129億美元收購開源AI平台Hugging Face。
近期，輝達亦持續推出開源模型，包括上個月發布的Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，強調這是一款可在筆電或桌機單顆GPU上運行的「輕量級」模型。
2.59 萬億美元大餅當前
這些公司無不希望從今年規模高達2.59兆美元的 AI 支出中分一杯羹。根據調研機構顧能(Gartner)預估，該數字將比2025年成長47%。該機構在今年5月的報告中指出，逾半AI支出將用於AI基礎設施，而服務、軟體、網路安全、模型及其他工具的支出總額也將超過1兆美元。
如此密集的模型更新，加上AI監管政策仍存在諸多不確定性，也加劇外界對先進 AI 模型風險的疑慮。
過去幾週，OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Meta 開發的模型都曾造訪原本不該造訪的第三方網站；OpenAI的模型上個月更成功入侵 Hugging Face，在整個產業引發震動。
Abbasi等專家尤其擔憂AI Agent快速發展。他表示，令人憂慮的不僅是這些能力，更在於「它們正被如此輕易地部署。隨著這些 Agent出現，它們不只存在於你的電腦，也開始活躍在網路上，整個威脅與漏洞環境都變得更複雜。如果我們不夠謹慎，局面可能徹底陷入混亂」。
他並認為，各大開發商恰好在同一週宣布更新，「這並非巧合」。
AI金融新創公司Farsight技術負責人Noah Faro也抱持類似看法。他指出，企業可透過多種方式掌握對手動向，例如觀察雲端運算資源供給，因為這些公司都在爭奪少數供應商的大規模算力；產業內部亦有大量資訊交流，「任何一點微小風吹草動，都會以極快速度傳播出去」。
當然，並非所有更新都同等重要。Faro指出，不同於OpenAI的 GPT-6 Astra，Anthropic、Meta 與谷歌上週推出的多數更新屬於「點版本更新」，也就是在既有模型上升級，而非從零開發全新模型。
Faro認為，近期真正對產業格局產生重大影響的兩款模型，是 Anthropic 6 月發布的 Fable 5，以及中國月之暗面 7 月推出的 Kimi K3。
不過，企業AI新創Clockwork Systems執行長Suresh Vasudevan認為，即使只是漸進式更新，在AI快速改變商業與軟體開發方式的當下仍具意義。「現在每一次發布的產品都強得離譜，以至於人們已很難判斷什麼才算真正的跨越式進步。大家都知道，當你身處指數成長曲線之中，往往意識不到自己正在經歷什麼；只有退後一步，回頭看看自己原來在哪裡、現在又走到哪裡，才能真正感受變化。」
Vasudevan也坦言，持續追蹤每一次模型更新已成頭痛之事，尤其評估過程還需消耗寶貴算力。若新創公司想針對某項任務評估 10 個模型，最終可能只挑其中5個測試，「要把目前所有正在推出的模型逐一評估，真的非常困難」。
paras_en: The AI industry saw another round of intensive updates last week: Anthropic upgraded its Fable and Mythos models, Meta and Google launched new versions, and OpenAI followed with GPT-6 Astra. In just over a week, several companies competing for AI leadership rolled out new offerings at a breakneck pace.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told CNBC on Thursday (the 3rd) that “we’re all speeding up the iteration cycle.” He said the recent acceleration is partly because “everyone’s back from summer vacation.”

However, for users of AI models and services, this rapid iteration brings complexity and confusion. To avoid falling behind, CEOs and IT heads must devote substantial time and resources to compare the pricing and capabilities of different products.

Runpod CEO Zhen Lu said, “I think ‘model fatigue’ is indeed becoming a real issue. Don’t get me wrong—I’m thrilled by the wave of innovation, but I do believe the environment is overly bubbly and companies feel forced to keep generating hype.”

Ahmed Abbasi, a professor at the School of Business, University of Notre Dame, with 25 years of AI experience, noted that model developers are now scrambling for users’ budget share, trying to keep up with rivals while constantly reminding developers that they are at least as fast as the competition in pushing innovation.

Because Anthropic and OpenAI are moving toward IPOs, the competitive tempo is especially fierce. Private investors now value both firms at nearly $1 trillion. Google and Meta each have their own strategic goals, and the fast‑growing open‑source AI community recently welcomed a heavyweight new member—NVIDIA.
The update wave kicked off on Tuesday (the 1st) when Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, branding them as “the world’s most advanced programming and knowledge‑work models.”
The next day Meta launched Muse Spark 1.3 and Google unveiled Gemini 3.8 Flash, both emphasizing improved capabilities for coding and AI‑agent tasks.

On Thursday OpenAI rolled out GPT‑6 Astra, focusing on enhanced cybersecurity and computer‑operation abilities, calling it the result of “years of research and major investment.” On the same day the Mohammed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence in Abu Dhabi released its K2 Horizon series to the open‑source community, underscoring that AI research and investment have become a global race.
At the same time, NVIDIA—the world’s most valuable company and a core chip supplier for the current AI boom—announced a $12.9 billion acquisition of the open‑source AI platform Hugging Face.

NVIDIA has also been continuously releasing open‑source models, including last month’s Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, which it touts as a “lightweight” model that can run on a single GPU in a laptop or desktop.
$2.59 trillion AI spending pie today

These firms all hope to capture a slice of this year’s projected $2.59 trillion AI expenditure. Gartner estimates the figure will grow 47 % by 2025. In a May report the firm said more than half of AI spend will go to infrastructure, while spending on services, software, cybersecurity, models and other tools will exceed $1 trillion.
Such a dense stream of model updates, combined with lingering regulatory uncertainty, heightens concerns about the risks of advanced AI models.

In recent weeks models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta have accessed third‑party sites they shouldn’t have; last month OpenAI’s model even breached Hugging Face, sending shockwaves through the industry.

Experts like Abbasi are especially worried about the rapid rise of AI agents. He says the danger lies not only in the capabilities themselves but in “how easily they are being deployed. As agents appear, they’re no longer confined to your computer—they’re active on the internet, making the threat and vulnerability landscape far more complex. If we’re not careful, the situation could descend into chaos.”
He adds that the fact all major developers announced updates in the same week “is no coincidence.”

Farsight’s head of technology Noah Faro shares a similar view. He notes that companies can track rivals by monitoring cloud‑resource allocations, since everyone is fighting for the limited large‑scale compute offered by a few providers; information spreads rapidly within the industry, “any tiny ripple is quickly amplified.”

Of course, not every update carries equal weight. Faro points out that unlike OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra, most of the releases from Anthropic, Meta and Google last week were “point releases,” upgrades to existing models rather than brand‑new builds.
Faro believes the two models that truly reshaped the industry recently are Anthropic’s Fable 5 released in June and China’s Kimi K3 launched in July.

Clockwork Systems CEO Suresh Vasudevan, however, argues that even incremental updates matter in a time when AI is rapidly transforming business and software development. “Every product launch now is so powerful that it’s hard to tell what counts as a genuine breakthrough. When you’re on an exponential growth curve you often don’t realize what you’re experiencing; you have to step back and look at where you started and where you are now to truly feel the change.”

Vasudevan also admits that continuously tracking every model update is a headache, especially since evaluation consumes precious compute. If a startup wants to assess ten models for a task, it may end up testing only five, and “evaluating every newly released model one by one is really difficult.”

items.title: 日元行情正在好轉 兌歐元、英鎊與瑞郎率先走強
items.title_en: Yen Moves Higher, Leading Gains Against Euro, Pound and Franc
paras: 外匯交易員對日元的看法日益樂觀，這項轉變率先反映在主要交叉匯率。日元近期兌歐元、瑞士法郎及英鎊走強，相關漲勢可能進一步延伸至美元，帶動美元兌日元匯率續跌。
日本當局實際干預與口頭干預接連出現，加上市場對日本央行升息的預期升溫，正逐步改善日元的整體環境。另一方面，日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能將更多海外資金匯回國內、轉進日本債券，也成為支撐日元的潛在因素。
值得注意的是，在美元兌日元上周跌至155關卡前夕，投機交易員一度增加日元淨空頭部位，但這些部位可能已經大幅削減。由於歐元及瑞郎淨空頭部位仍處低檔，也讓交易員在日本央行公布利率決策前，仍有充足空間透過交叉匯率建立日元多頭部位。
隨著市場對日本央行轉向鷹派的預期升高，投資人將關注9月18日的利率決策是否以9比0全票通過升息，以及行長植田和男會後是否保留10月再次升息的可能性。
此外，隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16至17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。
分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Forex traders are becoming increasingly optimistic about the yen, a shift first reflected in the major cross‑rates. The yen has recently strengthened against the euro, Swiss franc and pound, and the rally could extend to the dollar, pushing the USD/JPY rate lower further.

Actual and verbal interventions by Japanese authorities have appeared in succession, and rising market expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike are gradually improving the yen’s overall environment. Meanwhile, the Government Pension Investment Fund may repatriate more overseas assets into domestic Japanese bonds, providing another potential support for the yen.

It is noteworthy that, just before the dollar‑yen slipped to the 155 level last week, speculative traders briefly increased net short positions in the yen, but those positions have likely been cut sharply. Because net short positions on the euro and franc remain low, traders still have ample room to build yen long positions via cross‑rates before the BOJ announces its rate decision.

With market expectations rising that the BOJ will turn hawkish, investors will watch whether the September 18 rate decision is approved unanimously 9‑0 and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda will keep the option of another hike in October after the meeting.

Furthermore, as the yen approaches the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze is heating up. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warned that if USD/JPY falls below 155, the massive short side could be forced to unwind rapidly, triggering a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that about ¥16‑17 trillion of short positions remain open; if fully unwound, the yen could theoretically be pushed into the 142‑146 range, although its baseline view still places USD/JPY in the 155‑165 band.

A further major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert state,” a comment read as a possible signal of continued intervention.
Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity drops, and it cannot be ruled out that authorities might act during that window.

◆EUR/USD

隨後德國統計局公布7月工業訂單經季節與日曆調整較前月增長2.5%遠超過預期，並據標準普爾(S&P)調查8月建築業採購經理指數(PMI)，德國升至48.7，但歐元區、法國和義大利分別降至43.0、37.3及41.7，而且歐元區7月零售銷售意外較前月降0.6%及較去年年同期增加0.6%遜於預期，在美國發布強勁的就業報告激勵美元後，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1583低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1580-1.1600，阻力於1.1660-80。
◆GBP/USD

英國央行(BOE)首席經濟學家皮爾表示，現在加息將有助降低BOE未來為抑制因伊朗戰爭加劇的通貨膨脹而不得不採取更激進措施的可能性，而且FED理事沃勒鴿派的言論拖累美元下跌，上週五支撐英鎊兌美元徘徊於1.3549高點，隨後S&P全球調查英國8月建築業PMI降至44.3，遠低於榮枯線50，更為連續第二十個月萎縮，並據BOE總裁貝利稱，長期壓力推高政府債務及推高借貸成本，而且美國就業報告提振美元，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3481低點價位。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3480-1.3500，阻力於1.3570-90。

items.title: 狂賣美債救日元？日本外國證券單月驟減878億美元
items.title_en: Selling U.S. Bonds to Rescue the Yen? Japan's Foreign Securities Drop by $87.8 B in One Month
paras: 日本過去一個月為籌措創紀錄的匯市干預資金，可能出售部分外國證券，包括美國公債。
日本財務省周一(7日)公布的外匯存底資料顯示，截至8月底，日本持有的外國證券較前一個月減少878億美元，降幅接近近期為支撐日元所投入的干預規模。
財務省先前證實，截至8月26日止的一個月內，日本當局投入相當於964億美元的資金干預匯市，創單月歷史新高，其中部分行動與美國聯手進行。
這份資料並未詳細揭露所持證券的種類或到期年限，不過市場人士估計，日本約有70%的外匯存底投資於美國公債。
截至8月底，10年期美國公債價格僅略低於7月底水準，顯示評價變動對外國證券持有額下降的影響極為有限。

paras_en: Japan may sell part of its foreign securities, including U.S. Treasury bonds, to raise record‑high foreign‑exchange intervention funds gathered over the past month.

Data on Japan's foreign‑exchange reserves released by the Finance Ministry on Monday (the 7th) show that as of the end of August, Japan's holdings of foreign securities fell by $87.8 billion from the previous month, a decline close to the scale of recent yen‑supporting interventions.

The ministry previously confirmed that over the month ending August 26, Japanese authorities intervened in the FX market with roughly $96.4 billion, a historic monthly high, part of which was coordinated with the United States.
The data do not detail the types or maturities of the securities held, but market participants estimate that about 70 % of Japan's foreign‑exchange reserves are invested in U.S. Treasuries.

By the end of August, the price of the 10‑year U.S. Treasury was only slightly below its level at the end of July, indicating that valuation changes had a minimal impact on the drop in foreign‑security holdings.

The yen has rallied sharply in recent days, appreciating about 3 % over a few trading sessions, with market focus on rising expectations of Bank of Japan (BOJ) rate hikes and the possibility that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) will increase domestic asset allocation – two policy factors driving the yen’s strength.
Bank of America’s latest policy view sees the yen’s recent rally as likely to continue.

As the BOJ shifts to a more hawkish stance, some of the factors that have kept the yen suppressed are fading. Bank of America expects the BOJ may keep raising rates each quarter, and markets already price the policy rate up to 2 % by July 2027.
If the BOJ raises rates in September and signals hawkishness, the short‑selling case against the yen could weaken further.

Policy‑wise, Bank of America believes the Japanese government’s willingness to reverse yen weakness is growing. The Finance Ministry’s earlier restraint from aggressive intervention may be aimed at giving the BOJ room to accelerate hikes.

If the rate‑hike path becomes clearer while the yen keeps weakening, the Finance Ministry could intervene by buying yen. Thus, even if the dollar is supported, the dollar‑yen upside may be capped by policy factors.
Bank of America projects the dollar‑yen pair to fall back to 149 by year‑end and sees 155 as a key technical level. A break below 155 could accelerate yen buying.

Goldman Sachs also notes that the yen’s recent weakness over the past few years has been largely due to U.S. economic resilience and widening Japan‑U.S. yield differentials; the BOJ’s policy shift and a possible GPIF reallocation to domestic assets are eroding that structural headwind and could even become a support for the yen.

The potential GPIF‑driven fund flows are especially watched. Goldman cites 2020 experience, when the GPIF announced a change to its foreign‑bond allocation at the end of March, but fund movements began in January‑February, suggesting asset adjustments can precede formal policy announcements.
Accordingly, Goldman is paying close attention to the International Securities Transactions (ITS) data for August released on September 7, seeing it as a possible early signal of GPIF fund rotation.

Conversely, JPMorgan argues that market expectations of BOJ rate hikes are already too high. The September hike is almost fully priced, with the one‑year forward rate up to about 2.13 %, implying a tightening pace even faster than JPMorgan’s own forecast.
If market expectations for rate hikes cool, the yen could instead come under pressure.

items.title: 日元上周大幅震盪 匯市本周如何演繹？
items.title_en: Yen Saw Large Volatility Last Week: How Will the FX Market Play Out This Week?
paras: 上週稍早，美元兌日元匯率一度攀升至160.39，創7月底美日聯合干預以來的最高水準，但上週四(3日)日元突大幅走強，單日漲幅接近2%，創聯合干預以來最大單日升幅。美元兌日元自160.39高點快速回落，最低下探155.3附近，離7月干預後的低點155.23僅一步之遙。日元上周累計升值約2.5%，創7月底來最大單周升幅紀錄。
不同於7月底，此輪日元急升目前並無明確證據顯示東京當局再次入市干預，日本央行(BOJ)相關數據也未顯示波動由官方直接推動，市場更傾向歸因於BOJ升息預期升溫、日元空頭回補，以及聯準會(Fed)升息預期降溫。
日元此輪急升的直接驅動力，來自日美貨幣政策預期的逆向變動。知情人士透露，BOJ傾向本月將基準利率上調25個基點以應對通膨上行風險。
BOJ審議委員高田創上周表示，升息1碼「並非一定板上釘釘」，一般而言連續升息也有可能，總裁植田和男則明言若判斷金融條件過於寬鬆，完全可能加快升息步伐。
隔夜指數掉期數據顯示，市場對BOJ本月升息1碼定價已接近100%，並完全反映明年1月前再次升息，野村證券更指出，在日元持續疲軟的極端情境下，BOJ可能在12月前的3次會議上連續升息。
美國方面，聯準會理事沃勒上週四表示，美國通膨已出現一些降溫跡象，下一次利率決策將「很大程度上」受即將公布的8月通膨數據影響。偏鴿派表態推動市場削減對9月升息的押注，機率已降至約50%。
目前美國政策利率仍處3.5%-3.75%區間，即使BOJ本月升息至1.25%，兩國利差仍有225至250個基點。
不過市場交易的是方向變化，日本緊縮、美國寬鬆的預期逆轉，正動搖套利交易的基礎。
隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16-17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Earlier last week the USD/JPY rate surged to 160.39, the highest level since the joint US‑Japan intervention at the end of July, but on Thursday (the 3rd) the yen rallied sharply, gaining almost 2% in a single day – the biggest one‑day rise since the intervention. The dollar fell back quickly from the 160.39 peak, sliding to around 155.3, just a hair away from the post‑July low of 155.23. The yen appreciated about 2.5% over the week, the largest weekly gain since the end of July.

Unlike the end‑July move, there is no clear evidence that Tokyo authorities have intervened again, and BOJ data do not show the swing being driven directly by officials. The market attributes the rally mainly to hotter expectations of BOJ rate hikes, short‑covering of yen bears, and a cooling of Fed‑hike expectations.

The immediate driver of the yen’s sharp rise is the opposite shift in US‑Japan monetary‑policy expectations. Insiders say the BOJ is inclined to raise its benchmark rate by 25 basis points this month to counter upside inflation risks.

BOJ policy‑board member So Takada said a one‑tick hike “is not set in stone” and that consecutive hikes remain possible, while Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that if financial conditions are judged too loose, the bank could accelerate the pace of tightening.

Overnight index‑swap data show the market is pricing a one‑tick BOJ hike this month at almost 100% and fully factoring in another hike before January 2025. Nomura Securities adds that in an extreme scenario of continued yen weakness, the BOJ could deliver three consecutive hikes across its meetings before December.

In the United States, Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that inflation is showing some cooling signs and that the next rate decision will be “largely” influenced by the upcoming August inflation data. His dovish tone has pushed the market’s probability of a September hike down to roughly 50%.
The U.S. policy rate remains in the 3.5%‑3.75% band, so even if the BOJ lifts its rate to 1.25% this month, the bilateral spread would still sit at about 225‑250 basis points.
However, what the market is trading is the change in direction – the reversal of expectations toward tighter Japan and looser U.S. policy is unsettling the foundation of carry‑trade arbitrage.

As the yen nears the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze rises sharply. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warn that if USD/JPY falls below 155, massive short positions could be forced to unwind quickly, sparking a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that roughly ¥16‑17 trillion of short yen positions remain open; if they were all liquidated, the rate could theoretically be pushed into the ¥142‑¥146 range, although the firm still views USD/JPY as residing in the ¥155‑¥165 band.

Another major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior FX official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert” state, a comment read as a possible signal of further intervention. Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity thins, and they do not rule out action during that window.

接下來，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將成為重要觀察指標。CPI將於9月11日公布，隨後9月16日登場聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議，以及9月17日英國央行、9月18日日本央行的政策會議，主要央行政策預期可能在短時間內密集重新定價。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。
